jobs.description:
Are you a person who enjoys helping others? Are you currently seeking fulfillment in your professional life?

  

Hope Services is Silicon Valley’s leading provider of services to people with developmental disabilities and mental health needs. We seek candidates who share our inspirations & aspirations. Selection of staff is made on a competitive basis, and we are committed to promoting diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging at all levels..

**>>>>> 2025 Winner of Mercury News Best in Silicon Valley** **<<<<<**

**>>>>> ASPIRE to Excellence CARF Accredited** **<<<<<**

**>>>>> 2024 Great Nonprofits Top-Rated Nonprofit** **<<<<<**

**>>>>> Four-star Charity Navigator** **<<<<<**

**>>>>> 2024 Candid Gold Seal of Transparency** **<<<<<**

* **Compensation****: $5,859.00 per month**

**Purpose:**

Provides resources support and training to staff and clients to facilitate agency, program, and consumer goals. Supervision, hiring and training staff, budgeting and contract fulfillment, and assignments to perform or discharge special projects in areas of responsibility. Ensures maintenance of equipment, ordering of supplies, inventory and quality of service.

**Principle Responsibilities:**

The following responsibilities represent the essential functions of the position. An employee in this classification is responsible for carrying out the following functions:

1. Assures adequate program staffing through scheduling, recruitment, hiring,

and orientation of direct service, substitute and volunteer staff as assigned.

Provides all aspects of supervision, evaluation, and training of staff.

2. Acts as a resource for rehabilitation, program development, community

based employment and activities, acts as a liaison between program

services and the community.

3. Provides oversight of daily operations and services including case

management, communications, and advocacy, assures quality services are

provided in timely manner.

4. Assures timely communications with persons served, families, care

providers, funding sources, staff, management and community.

5. Participates in the development and implementation of the Agency planning

effort including departmental budgeting, policies and procedures, and the

implementation of Agency goals.

6. Oversees accuracy and timeliness of billing, payroll, funding, DOL

compliance, inventories, training records, and various internal and external

reports.

7. Conducts tours, presentations and client intakes.

8. Assures compliance with all safety regulations.

9. In the absence of a manager, if assigned, may act in that capacity.

10. Provides direct service in program operations as needed to assure adequate

staffing ratios.

11. Acts as a mandated abuse reporter.

12. May perform special projects or other duties as assigned to assure the

efficiency of the program.

**Minimum Qualifications**:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent plus three years of related experience working with people with disabilities in a rehabilitation environment.

**Reports To:** Manager

**Supervisory Responsibility****:** yes

**Required knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

1. Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, database and spreadsheet

2. Ability to communicate effectively and provide excellent customer service

3. Ability to facilitate systems and checks to assure delivery of quality service

and product to internal and external customers

4. Knowledge of the principles of management, supervision, planning, fiscal

management, fair employment practices, regulations, safety, health and

client rights

5. Ability to observe, evaluate, document and communicate verbally and in

writing

6. Knowledge of rehabilitation and program development

**Environmental Conditions:**

Constant movement around service area, and travel into the community. Time spent sitting, using a computer station, periods of intense concentration, using the telephone, paperwork. Time spent in meetings, travel to various work site locations throughout three counties. Exposure to outdoor weather and environmental conditions.

Positions connected to a production environment are also exposed to times of fast paced activity, loud noise and to dust and airborne particles.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator - HUB
jobs.description:
**About Bill Wilson Center:**  
Bill Wilson Center provides services to children, youth, young adults, and families in Santa Clara County. Additionally, we reach clients through our street outreach and crisis line programs. Bill Wilson Center programs focus on housing, mental health care, supportive services, and advocacy. Bill Wilson Center is committed to working with the community to ensure that every youth has access to the range of services needed to grow to be healthy and self-sufficient adults. A key component of Bill Wilson Center's philosophy encompasses a strength-based approach to improving the lives of the youth and young families in our communities. Bill Wilson Center has been providing services to runaway and homeless youth since 1973. Join us and become a difference maker at Bill Wilson Center!

**Job Summary:**  
In partnership with County of Santa Clara, Bill Wilson Center provides independent living skills and basic needs for foster youth. The HUB Coordinator welcomes and greets youth and provides orientation of facilities and services. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform all essential duties and responsibilities satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Essential Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate with the Hub/ILP Program Manager (PM) to ensure the opening and closing of the HUB and appropriate in-person coverage at the front desk. Provide copies of sign in sheets to the PM as requested.
* Assist staff to verify client eligibility.
* Ensure that client and program records are maintained and up to date, ensure data entry is timely in Efforts to Outcomes (ETO) database as required.
* Provide reports as required to track client participation in services.
* Plan, coordinate and facilitate meetings, workshops and events. Create flyers and outreach messaging as necessary.
* Coordinate the daily monitoring and maintenance of basic services such as kitchen, showers, washers/dryers, and HUB Mart.
* Provide orientation and tours to clients, visitors and other stakeholders.
* Provide peer support to HUB members. Responsible for supervising clients on the HUB floor and ensuring rules and policies are being observed. Issue consequences to clients for violations and report incidents to the program manager immediately. Work cooperatively with all co-located partners to ensure safety of the HUB and adherence to all procedures.
* Mediate client concerns and conflict following applicable policies and procedures.
* Participate in outreach by text, phone, email and/or social media to engage them in services.
* Participate in administering and maintaining HUB Instagram, web site, and other social media accounts as directed.
* Responsible for soliciting food and HUB Mart donations. Coordinate with the Development Department to solicit monetary donations.
* Responsible for supplies inventory, management and ordering.
* Responsible for arranging meeting room requests.
* Provides transportation and/or coordinates client transportation HUB/ILP events.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree plus 2 years of comparable work experience. Experience working with foster care system, probation and/or transition age clients, or personal experience in the above. Experience working with culturally diverse clients required. Knowledge of local Child Welfare and Juvenile Probation policies, procedures and governing legislation preferred, but not required.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Driving is a requirement of the job. Must have possession of current driver’s license, access to a vehicle and personal automobile insurance. Carry a valid driver’s license, copy of vehicle registration, and Insurance in the event that coordinator needs to pick-up food donation, buying
* general food/supplies, and transporting clients.
* Current CPR and First Aid Certification required (or complete within 30 days of hire).
* Fingerprinting/background check as required by the Department of Justice and/or Title XXII regulations. TB test required.
* Must be punctual, efficient and organized; effective and professional under pressure. Ability to balance excellent client care with meeting deadlines and ensuring positive program goals and outcomes. Excellent communication skills - must be personable and informative when presenting
* Bill Wilson Center programs and services.
* Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Must be able to communicate effectively. Bilingual communication skills are a plus.
* Ability to work with basic mathematical concepts as required for reporting.
* Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
* To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of Internet software; spreadsheet software and word processing software and Internet research skills.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Custom Scope**

Under the general direction of the Associate Director, Campus Design and Construction, the incumbent is accountable for project management services to ensure design and construction projects are on schedule, within budget, high-quality, cost-effective, and appropriate to client program needs. Projects focus on renovation work within world-class research facilities and the administrative spaces that support them. The incumbent has a first-line responsibility for communicating effectively with project stakeholders, ranging from departmental administrators to highly technical researchers and facilities support staff. Excellent customer service skills are essential at all phases of the project.

The incumbent organizes, plans, and controls the design and construction efforts on projects ranging from $5,000 - $70,000,000. Services include all elements of project management from concept through project closeout, including initial scoping, budgeting, funding, procurement, impact mitigation, construction management, and closeout of large and small projects.

This involves selecting professional design staff (architects and engineers), general contractors and subcontractors, coordinating the activities of clients, construction inspectors, and others associated with the projects; managing project progress to achieve overall project objectives consistent with department standards and in alignment with customer expectations including, budget, cost and quality; resolving problems that arise in the projects; working with state agency officials to ensure compliance and safety.

Emphasis is placed on the incumbent's ability to complete the following in a complex research environment: analyze available information to provide conceptual-level estimates at early stages of project development, review constructability and suggest alternative solutions, and proactively manage the design phase to ensure efficient and cost-effective project delivery.

Project managers may be responsible for coordinating the activities of Real Estate Assistant Project Managers as directed.

**Department Overview**

The organization of UCSF Real Estate is focused on the development, planning, delivery, and management of physical space for UCSF. Key responsibilities include a unified approach to oversee the active UCSF growth planned on a multi-site campus and to manage the complex metropolitan environments affecting capital assets and projects, and efforts to align municipal challenges with maximum effectiveness in support of the UCSF mission.

UCSF Real Estate is an integrated unit that enables the alignment of development, planning, design, construction, and management of facilities and a lease portfolio of 1M square feet across UCSF. Services are provided through the following departments: Building Permit Services, Campus Design and Construction, Campus Planning, Construction Contract Administration, Health Design and Construction, Health Major Capital Projects, Real Estate Services, Benioff Children’s Hospital Oakland Capital Program Management and support through Business Intelligence, and Finance, Administration and Operations.

The UCSF Campus Design & Construction department is responsible for providing comprehensive capital project delivery services to the research, academic, administrative, campus life services units on the Parnassus, Mt Zion, ZSFG (Zuckerberg San Francisco General), Mission Center, Mission Bay, campuses including leased properties and satellite locations in San Francisco and throughout the greater Bay Area and Fresno. Project types include new “ground up” buildings, seismic upgrades of existing buildings, major infrastructure & technology upgrades, major facilities investment and deferred maintenance programs, renovations and upgrades of existing labs, offices, education space, student and faculty housing facilities, and full floor renovations.

The team is responsible and accountable to assure projects are delivered in accordance with all project objectives including cost, scope, and schedule, remain compliant with all public contract code, UCOP (University of California Office of the President), and UCSF policies, and satisfy the customer requirements. The team serves as the focal point of Campus capital project delivery and relies deeply on close partnerships within real estate and a wide variety of additional stakeholders across UCSF to provide a comprehensive solution for capital project and program delivery services. The current program is $2.8B and consists of more than 200 projects.

The combined UCSF Campus and Health organizations include approximately 198 UCSF and 38 contract personnel; operating/recharge budgets of more than $52.2M per year; current year capital project expenditures of $900M; and oversight and responsibility for > $9.7B long-range capital development.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in architecture, Engineering, Planning or in a related field and three to five years of experience in managing all phases of capital projects; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Financial skills to prepare, monitor and manage project budgets, evaluate cost estimates, and review payment requests.
* Strong communication skills on a one-to-one basis or in a group setting with project team, leaders, stakeholders, contractors and consultants.
* Experience managing contractors ensuring compliance with work scope and budget.
* Skilled in building, maintaining and nurturing strong professional relationships.
* Strong Microsoft Office and project manager software skills. Working knowledge of CAD drawing programs and architectural design application programs.
* Project management skills, including skill to manage complex projects.
* Demonstrated skills in problem recognition / avoidance / resolution.
* Experience leading multi-discipline project groups on small and medium complex projects or programs

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.

As Vanta's revenue organization scales, new hire onboarding is the foundation for long-term GTM performance. As the owner of our new hire bootcamp experience, you'll run and continuously improve the programs that set every new revenue hire up for success from day one. That includes our global live bootcamp in San Francisco and role specific learning journeys to help every Revenue hire ramp successfully. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role that shapes the first impression every new revenue hire has of Vanta.

You'll focus on two core areas:

* Global New Hire Bootcamp Delivery (San Francisco): Own the planning, delivery, facilitation, and measurement of our live bootcamp in San Francisco. Create a consistent, engaging foundation for new revenue hires and connect the experience to their broader onboarding journeys.

* Post-Bootcamp New Hire Learning Journeys: Own program management for onboarding through the first 90 days, including shared Revenue learning and role-specific journeys. Partner with Field Enablement to develop and maintain experiences for Account Executives, Solutions Engineers, Customer Success Managers, Account Managers, Sales Development Reps and other customer-facing roles.

This will be a hybrid role based in our San Francisco office.

**What you’ll do as a GTM Program Manager, Revenue Onboarding at Vanta:**

* Own end-to-end execution of Revenue bootcamp, including program planning, logistics, facilitator preparation, live facilitation, and learner and stakeholder communications.
* Build and maintain a scalable onboarding curriculum with subject matter experts, covering Vanta’s product, customers, sales methodology, competitive landscape, and culture.
* Partner with Field Enablement to connect bootcamp with role-specific learning, practice, and readiness milestones throughout each new hire’s first 90 days.
* Establish clear ownership, timelines, and review processes so onboarding content stays accurate, relevant, and aligned with business priorities.
* Equip hiring managers with visibility into onboarding progress and clear opportunities to reinforce learning through coaching and feedback.
* Identify gaps by role, region, and stage of onboarding, then translate learner feedback, manager input, and performance data into a prioritized improvement roadmap.
* Define and track program effectiveness with Enablement and RevOps partners, using measures such as learner feedback, readiness, ramp time, and role-specific productivity milestones.
* Partner across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, RevOps, and People to deliver a coordinated experience, working with regional Enablement teammates to adapt for local needs.

**How to be successful in this role:**

* Must be located in the San Francisco Bay area.
* 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, onboarding, or program management, ideally in a revenue organization.
* Experience designing and facilitating live, in-person training for sales or customer-facing teams.
* Track record of running large, multi-stakeholder programs end to end.
* Experience defining and reporting on program metrics such as ramp, NPS, and productivity.
* Experience in SaaS; experience supporting a technical product is preferred.
* Strong ability to diagnose capability gaps and translate them into focused priorities.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills across varied audiences.
* Strong business partnership and cross-functional collaboration skills, including with senior sales and CS leaders.
* Ability to operate independently and manage ambiguity.
* Uses AI in day-to-day work to amplify their skills and strengthen their outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar.
* Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

jobs.description:
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a **Front Office Manager** , you’re not just overseeing daily front office operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

  

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

* **Manage daily front office operations:** Oversee Front Office activities including guest service, registration, room inventory, and adherence to policies and standards
* **Monitor and elevate service:** Track guest satisfaction, address service issues, and guide the team to implement improvements that enhance the guest experience
* **Implement revenue initiatives:** Promote hotel services and execute up-selling tactics to drive room occupancy and revenue growth
* **Facilitate team knowledge:** Provide regular updates and training to ensure the team is well-informed of hotel offerings, services, and local attractions
* **Delight our guests:** Welcome guests, respond to inquiries, and resolve concerns promptly to uphold service standards
* **Inspire and develop the team:** Supervise and support front office team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including\*:

* **Own a piece of Hilton** – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future

* **Generous paid time off (PTO)** – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
* **Health & welfare benefits** – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
* **Financial security for your future** – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next

*\*Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.*

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

jobs.title: Trusted Access Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Trust & Safety - San Francisco

**About the team**

Trusted Access helps eligible customers access and use advanced AI capabilities with appropriate safeguards. Within User Safety & Risk Operations, we connect customer onboarding, eligibility review, access provisioning, and support into a service customers can navigate with confidence.

We work with Product, Engineering, technical support, regional operations, and customer-facing teams to resolve difficult access problems and improve the systems behind them. Our work combines sound judgment on individual cases with better products, clearer guidance, and automation that reduces unnecessary friction.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a senior operations leader to own the Trusted Access operating strategy and lead a team of risk-operations specialists. You will set priorities across programs, build a reliable customer access service, and hire, manage, and develop your direct reports.

This role combines program ownership with formal people management. You will establish shared commitments with technical support and regional escalation leaders, who manage their own teams, and bring those groups together around customer outcomes. You’ll stay close enough to complex cases to challenge assumptions while giving specialists the ownership and capacity to fix recurring problems.

Success means customers reach the right access outcome with clear communication, teams make consistent decisions, and the service scales with less avoidable escalation and manual work.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own the operating strategy and roadmap across Trusted Access programs, translating customer needs and organizational priorities into clear service commitments, ownership, and investment decisions.
* Build a coherent customer journey from application and eligibility review through approval, provisioning coordination, and confirmed access, including appeals and subsequent access changes. Establish clear handoffs and route exceptions to authorized decision-makers.
* Hireance gaps, and build the capabilities needed as programs grow.
* Make capacity and prioritization decisions across urgent customer needs, launch readiness, and lasting improvements. Coordinate regional coverage, vendor support, and backup with partner teams while protecting time to eliminate recurring work.
* Lead consequential customer escalations, bringing incomplete or conflicting evidence into a clear decision process. Align owners on the next action and ensure customers receive accurate updates and a clear resolution.
* Turn support patterns into a prioritized roadmap with Product and Engineering: improve onboarding, provisioning workflows, tooling, self-service, and AI-assisted operations. Validate that changes work before expanding them.
* Establish measures of service health and decision quality. Distinguish fast responses from actual resolution, investigate persistent delays, and use evidence to change priorities.
* Prepare new programs and customer channels for launch and scale. Align support responsibilities, review standards, customer guidance, and technical dependencies; make readiness gaps and tradeoffs clear to leadership.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* Have built and run complex customer support, onboarding, access, risk, or service operations, with measurable improvements beyond handling more volume.
* Have formally managed people through hiringance decisions, and can show how your leadership increased the team’s capability and ownership. 5+ years of management experience preferred.
* Can make defensible tradeoffs among customer commitments, safeguards, service quality, and capacity, even when stakeholders disagree or the evidence is incomplete.
* Have led work across teams you do not manage, resolving ownership gaps and negotiating commitments that hold up in execution.
* Are analytically and technically fluent enough to diagnose workflow failures, evaluate automation, and partner effectively on product and provisioning changes.
* Communicate with precision and empathy, from explaining an access blocker to a customer to presenting a difficult investment decision to leadership.

jobs.title: Strategy and Operations Manager, AI-Native Business Operations
jobs.description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

**Strategy and Operations Manager, AI-Native Business Operations**
==================================================================

San Jose, California, United States

**Job category:** Business Operations **Job ID:** 137017-en\_US

**Job Summary**
---------------

This role helps the leaders of NetApp's product organization decide where people and money go, and makes those decisions faster and better informed. It spans planning, forecasting and tracking the organization's people and resources, and the budget across headcount, open reqs, software, cloud and AI spend. On each of these the analyst brings a point of view, not just the numbers behind it.

The role combines three skillsets that usually live in three different people: the consultant who frames an ambiguous question and lands a recommendation with senior leaders; the analyst who builds the model and can defend every number in it; and the AI-first builder who turns recurring work into systems that run themselves. The unit of delivery is a better decision, made sooner, on numbers leaders trust.

The role sits within the AI-Native Business Operations team in the product organization, and reports to the Director, AI-Native Business Operations. The team works in close partnership with Finance, HR, Talent Acquisition and engineering leadership across the product organization.

A few principles shape how the team approaches its work:

* **We start from outcomes, not from tasks.** The first question on any piece of work is what it is for and what good looks like, not how to automate the current steps.
* **One source of truth.** People, plans and spend live in one trusted, connected source, and every report and dashboard draws from it.
* **AI first, with human judgment throughout.** AI shortens the time to an outcome; our judgment tests every assumption and validates each step, from the source data to the final recommendation.
* **Accountability does not stop at the answer.** The analyst stands behind the method and the data as well as the result.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Plan, forecast and track.** Build the plans and forecasts for the product organization's people and resources, and track them month by month: where engineering capacity and spend go across products and investment themes, and how hiring, attrition and backfills move against plan.
* **Manage the budget.** Hold the product organization's spend against target with Finance, from headcount and open reqs to software, cloud and AI, and find where to consolidate, renegotiate or stop.
* **Advise product leadership.** Turn the numbers into a clear point of view for vice presidents and their staff, and run the planning cycles and leadership reviews where those decisions get made.
* **Operationalize strategic initiatives.** Take a leadership priority from idea to working program: define its scope, set milestones and checkpoints, build the plan and put it in motion, then measure the results and keep leadership updated as it lands.
* **Automate the recurring work.** Build agents, automations and dashboards with Claude and the team's other AI tools that make each cycle take less effort than the last.
* **Keep the source of truth trustworthy.** Maintain the connected data behind every leadership view, with the checks and audit trail that let a leader defend any figure in front of Finance or the executive staff.
* **Work across functions.** Partner with Finance, HR, Talent Acquisition, IT and data owners on access, definitions and changes, within NetApp standards for privacy and acceptable use.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience, including a minimum of 3 years in consulting. This experience may have been gained in:

* The strategy, operations or analytics practice of a management consulting firm, such as McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Deloitte, or a comparable practice
* A business operations, strategy and operations, or FP&A team at an AI-first technology company
* A founding or early operating role at a startup building AI-native products

* Uses AI as the default way of working, across analysis, writing and building, with examples to show, and builds validation into each step so the speed never costs accuracy. Familiarity with Claude Code or Cursor is preferred.
* Learns new domains, systems and data quickly, and acts without waiting for a perfect brief; comfortable where the problem is still being defined.
* Expert scenario and financial modeling: headcount, cost and what-if models that leaders use to make decisions, and the judgment to spot when a number is wrong.
* A technical, hands-on approach to data: reads data architectures and table schemas, writes the joins in SQL or Python, and treats data preparation as part of the job, from cleaning and de-duplicating records to validating formats and keys before any number is used. Experience with workforce or finance data in systems such as Workday or Snowflake is a plus.
* A track record of influencing directors and vice presidents without authority, with recommendations that were acted on.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to disagree productively and adjust as evidence evolve

Diamond Technology is a Technical Services company. We have a client who is a large local public organization with an opening for the following position:

JOB TITLE: IT Project Manager  
NUMBER OF OPENINGS: 1  
DESIRED START DATE: Late Dec 2026  
LOCATION: HYBRID - On Site Mondays & Tuesdays

HOURLY RATE: $85ph to $95ph

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS (PASS/FAIL)**

* **MQ1:** A bachelor’s degree in CS/IT or a related field plus 2 years managing integrated information systems projects, OR 6+ years of that experience.
* **MQ2:** Within the last 5 years, you were lead PM on at least 2 integrated IT systems or infrastructure projects, with direct responsibility for scope, the integrated schedule, the budget, and risk/issue management. We’ll need a specific example of each.
* **MQ3:** You’re authorized to work in the U.S., you consent to being submitted and interviewed, you can start within 30 days of Notice to Proceed, you can work Monday–Friday, 8–5 Pacific, and any remote work will be within the U.S.

**Top Skills**

* Lead IT project management with direct ownership of scope, integrated schedule, budget, and risk/issue management
* Building project charters, RACI matrices, communication plans, risk/issue/change plans, and baseline schedules with critical path
* Bottom-up budgeting, securing funding from client departments, and preparing procurement requests and RFPs
* Stakeholder, vendor, and executive communication, governance reporting, and escalation management
* Delivering infrastructure, network/voice, cloud, or cybersecurity modernization projects through UAT, cutover, and handoff to operations

**Nice to have:** PMP, CAPM, Agile/Scrum, or ITIL certification; public-sector or government IT experience.  

**BUSINESS REQUIREMENTS**  
“The IT Project Manager will perform duties including, but not limited to:”

* Project Leadership

* Lead complex, multi-year IT modernization projects from planning through implementation and operational transition.
* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, budgets, resource plans, and success metrics.
* Develop and maintain project charters, work plans, risk registers, communication plans, and executive reporting.
* Ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and aligned with organizational priorities.

* Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration

* Serve as the primary liaison between IT leadership, business departments, vendors, and external partners.

* Lead cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and transparency.

* Technical & Operational Execution

* Oversee implementation activities including system integration, testing, deployment, user acceptance testing (UAT), and production readiness.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security, architecture, and governance standards.

* Risk, Change, and Vendor Management

* Identify project risks, dependencies, and issues; develop and execute mitigation strategies.
* Lead organizational change management efforts, including communication, training, and user adoption activities.
* Manage vendor relationships, procurement activities, contract execution, and third-party consulting engagements.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure contractual deliverables are achieved.

* Governance and Continuous Improvement

* Support enterprise project governance, portfolio management processes, and project management best practices.
* Develop and present project performance metrics, dashboards, and recommendations to leadership.
* Promote continuous improvement and adoption of industry best practices in project delivery and service management.

**SCOPE OF WORK**  
Task 1: Develop Project Charter; clarifying what is in scope vs. out of scope.

* Identify and document key project deliverables
* Identify and document stakeholder roles and responsibilities, build RACI
* Build and document Communication Plan
* Build Risk, Issue and Change management Plan

Task 2: Develop Integrated Project Schedule with input from project team, client stakeholders and vendors.

* Document project dependencies and critical path
* Document project tasks and task owners, duration and effort
* Document project milestones and baseline schedule

Task 3: Develop project budget based on input from team, secure funding from client department and submit procurement asks if needed for project.

* Develop bottoms up budget estimate with input from cross functional project team
* Secure client funding through Interdepartmental agreements
* Develop and submit procurement requests, RFPs, etc. where needed for project

Flexible work from home options available.

### **Position Summary:**

This position manages SFRRN grants and contracts and supports operations across its 8 network partners, while collaborating with community organizations, coalitions, and government agencies. The SFRRN Program Manager also partners closely with the SFILEN Program Manager and supervises the SFILEN & SFRRN Program Coordinator.

### 

### **About Chinese for Affirmative Action (CAA)**

CAA was founded in 1969 to protect the civil and political rights of Chinese Americans and to advance multiracial democracy in the United States. Today, CAA is a progressive voice in and on behalf of the broader Asian American and Pacific Islander community. CAA advocates for systemic change that protects immigrant rights, promotes language diversity, and remedies racial and social injustice.

### 

### **About SF Rapid Response Network (SFRRN)**

The San Francisco Rapid Response Network (SFRRN) is a 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, immigration enforcement response hotline serving the City of San Francisco. Founded in 2008, and revamped in 2016, SFRRN was one of the first, and remains one of the few 24/7 immigration enforcement response hotlines in the country. SFRRN houses 8 immigration focused community based organizations who staff the 24/7 hotline, verifies immigration enforcement activity in San Francisco, connects San Franciscans to legal and accompaniment services, and provides immigration centered Know-Your-Rights education to immigrant community members citywide.

  

In 2026, CAA became the lead and fiscal agency to house the San Francisco Immigrant Legal & Education Network (SFILEN) and SFRRN. As a founding and active member of these networks, CAA is committed to the health and wellbeing of both collaboratives in order that partners may continue to serve immigrant communities with immigration legal services and community education in the face of heightened immigration enforcement and rising xenophobia.

### 

### **Position Description**

Reporting to the Managing Director of Programs, the Program Manager manages SFRRN grants and contracts, oversees and supports network operations amongst the 8 partners, and works closely with other community based organizations, collaboratives, and government entities to ensure the success of these strategies. Some partner groups include: The San Francisco Immigrant Legal Defense Collaborative, California Coalition for Immigrant Justice, Northern California Rapid Response Networks, Bay Area Rapid Response Networks, as well as entities coordinating accompaniment, verification, and city agencies such as the Mayor’s Office, Office of Civic Engagement and Immigrant Affairs, San Francisco Police Department and San Francisco Sheriff's Office. This position works very closely with the San Francisco Immigrant Legal and Education Network (SFILEN) Program Manager, and supervises the SFILEN and SFRRN Program Coordinator. Ensure the general public receives timely

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

*Manage SFRRN Contracts and Grants*

* Host regular SFRRN meetings (Monthly Dispatcher Meetings, Monthly Executive Director Meetings, and adhoc meetings and trainings as needed), including agenda setting, facilitating, and completing follow-up as needed, with decision makers, dispatchers, and with external partners.
* Ensure network and partner success in timely implementation and completion of: program activities, deliverables and goals, performance measures, reports, partner agreements including compliance requirements, and other funder requirements across all SFRRN related funding sources.
* Manage SFRRN programming towards demonstrable impact, timely completion, and strengthened partnerships.
* Coordinate with AACRE Capacity, and CAA leadership on contract implementation, including execution of contracts, MOUs, compliance, reporting and invoicing, and program development and evaluation.
* Assist with budget planning and development, expense tracking, and budget monitoring on SFRRN related funding.
* Work with SFILEN and SFRRN Program Coordinator to coordinate meetings and successful completion of monthly invoicing, reporting, and documentation processes.
* Ensure smooth and efficient operations and communications amongst partners.
* Develop and maintain operational systems, tracking tools, reporting processes, program files, and documentation necessary to support effective and efficient network operations.
* Respond to partner inquiries.
* Train and onboard new hotline dispatchers including maintaining and updating all hotline dispatcher training materials with timely updates related to immigration enforcement policies, court protocols, and other issues that may impact migrants at risk of arrest, detention, and deportation.

  

*Coordinate Responses to Immigration Enforcement Activity Against San Francisco Residents in San Francisco*

* Coordinate with verifiers to respond to reports of sightings of immigration enforcement activity and/or agents within San Francisco.
* Ensure directly impacted migrants receive legal support through coordination between dispatchers and SFILDC, and other parties as needed.
* Ensure families of those arrested, detained, or deported receive wrap around support through appropriate referrals by dispatchers.
* Coordinate with local law enforcement as needed, to clarify roles in law enforcement activities, and confirm/disconfirm local law enforcement involvement in federal immigration enforcement activities.
* and accurate information regarding immigration enforcement in San Francisco. (See “Communication” below).
* Manage scheduling for SFRRN dispatcher shifts to ensure appropriate coverage.
* Create and maintain systems, processes, procedures, and technology to support efficient and effective rapid response to immigration emergencies, including regular assessments and evaluations with dispatchers, SFILDC, community partners, and technology team to troubleshoot issues that impede SFRRN operations.

### **Description**

Alta Planning + Design seeks an **Associate** **Landscape Architect (I-II)** for our **Oakland** location. Alta’s landscape architecture practice is dynamic and diverse, contributing to projects at a variety of scales with a people-centered approach to our work. We consider ourselves connectors of people and place, and we work directly with local communities on data-driven, engagement-centered designs. Through all of our projects at Alta, we aspire to promote environmental harmony and resiliency, social capital, and equity through design excellence. This position is a great opportunity for someone who shares these values and who is interested in an interdisciplinary project environment working on a range of project types, from parks to streetscapes to greenways.
  
  
**About Alta**  
Alta is a mission driven company working to mitigate climate change and advance safety and social justice by shaping sustainable, people-centered communities. We bring together expertise across planning, design, engineering, education and encouragement programs, and community engagement to help communities thrive. Our work is grounded in the belief that how places are designed and experienced has a profound impact on equity, health, and opportunity—and that people should always be at the heart of those decisions.

Founded in 1996, Alta was at the forefront of the active transportation movement and has spent nearly 30 years partnering with communities to imagine a more connected, resilient, and inclusive future. Today, with more than 225 staff across the United States and beyond, we are a global leader in creating environments that support everyday life, strengthen human connection, and respond to the challenges of a changing world. Alta offers the opportunity to collaborate across disciplines, contribute to meaningful work at every scale, and be part of a team committed to making lasting, positive change for people and the places they call home.

The Amazon Devices Beta (ADB) Team is your hall pass to play at work!! We are responsible for the “real world validation” for Kindle eReaders, Fire Tablets, FireTV products, and Emerging products…think, Amazon Smart Oven and Amazon Basics Microwave. How do we do this? By playing with these products every day! We work with product and engineering teams to prepare new product launches, system software and app updates, and marketplace expansions. Our goal is to gather feedback and expose issues and bugs prior to the product launching, so we delight our customers with products beyond their expectations.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The ADB Team needs an experienced Program Manager to help us build and execute programs to validate the customer experience during the product development cycle. Project Manager – Fire Protection & Life Safety

**1 Opening | Palo Alto, CA & Bay Area VA Facilities | Hybrid**

*HurtVet Fire & Security*

Leading Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) with contracts nationwide and multiple offices across the US seeks an experienced Project Manager to lead fire protection and life safety service contracts at government facilities in the Palo Alto and greater Bay Area. This role oversees fire alarm and fire sprinkler/suppression inspection, testing, and maintenance programs at VA medical facilities in Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Mountain View, Sunnyvale, and Livermore, CA. HurtVet specializes in fire protection, life safety, and physical security services for numerous federal agencies.

In This Role You Will

* Serve as HurtVet's local lead and primary point of contact for fire protection and life safety contracts at government facilities, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with the contract, NFPA codes, and Joint Commission requirements

* Plan and schedule all required inspection, testing, and maintenance activity so that code-required intervals are met across multiple facilities

* Manage HurtVet's subcontractor partners and employees from scheduling through documentation and closeout, and coordinate repairs of identified deficiencies

* Work with HurtVet's finance department to make sure completed work is accurately billed and invoiced on time

Primary Tasks & ResponsibilitiesContract Management & Compliance

* Develop a working command of each contract's requirements and ensure HurtVet and its partners perform to them, including required test frequencies, reporting deadlines, and deficiency correction timeframes

* Maintain a regular on-site presence and meet in person with the customer's facility representatives to review the work plan, findings, documentation, and follow-up items

* Act as first line of defense in emergency response (24/7) with call backs within 1 hour and possible on-site response within 4 hours (to be specially compensated when off-hours)

* Interpret and apply NFPA 72, NFPA 25, NFPA 101, and Joint Commission requirements to scheduling, testing, documentation, and deficiency resolution decisions

* Support the company's quality control program, including testing schedules, inspection checklists, and a system for tracking and closing out deficiencies

* Track contract deliverables and deadlines; identify risks early and escalate issues to HurtVet leadership as needed

* When requested, participate in facility project meetings with third-party contractors, engineers, and customer staff to provide input on projects that impact fire alarm and suppression systems

Scheduling & Work Coordination

* Build and maintain rolling monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual inspection and testing schedules; submit upcoming schedules to the customer in advance as required

* Coordinate site access, system bypasses/impairments, and notifications with facility staff so testing can be performed safely and with minimal disruption to patient care areas

* Coordinate repairs of deficiencies found during inspections, including obtaining scope and pricing, securing customer approval, and confirming completion

* Coordinate planning for extended system outages, including any required Interim Life Safety Measures (ILSM) and notifications

* Serve as the escalation point for urgent service issues and ensure emergency response is dispatched through the appropriate partner

jobs.title: Postmarket Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**About this opportunity:**

  

Freenome is approaching FDA approval and commercial launch of SimpleScreen™, our cfDNA-based colorectal cancer detection test. As we cross that milestone, we need a dedicated owner for the postmarket quality infrastructure that commercial launch demands — someone who can build and run a complaint handling program that works across two distinct regulatory environments.

  

This role also owns the CAPA program — ensuring that complaints and quality events drive real corrective action, not just documentation. You will serve as the escalation point and technical mentor for junior team members managing non-conformances and laboratory incidents, and you will be the Quality interface with our commercial partners to ensure customer and partner feedback is captured, evaluated, and acted on. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant cross-functional influence and a mentorship mandate. The role reports directly to the Senior Director, Quality Assurance and is an onsite role based in our Brisbane, California headquarters.

  

**What you'll do:**

* Own the end-to-end complaint handling process — from intake and triage through technical investigation, root cause analysis, disposition, and closure — applying the distinct regulatory requirements applicable to CAP/CLIA laboratory quality events and IVD postmarket complaints under 21 CFR 820/QMSR and ISO 13485.
* Own the CAPA program: ensure that complaints, non-conformances, and laboratory quality events drive rigorous corrective action with documented root cause analysis, implementation, and effectiveness verification. Maintain CAPA records in the eQMS with traceability required for CAP/CLIA compliance.
* Serve as the escalation point and technical mentor for junior team members managing non-conformances and laboratory incidents — coaching investigation rigor, reviewing findings, and ensuring quality events at all levels feed appropriately into the CAPA program.
* Serve as the primary Quality liaison to commercial partners and customer-facing teams as it relates to complaints and CAPA: establish and maintain processes for capturing, routing, and evaluating partner- and customer-reported feedback and complaints, and communicate investigation status and corrective actions back to relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor and analyze complaint, CAPA, and non-conformance trends across all quality event streams; identify systemic issues and escalate with supporting analysis and recommended corrective actions to Quality leadership.
* Compile and present quality signals data: complaint volumes, CAPA quantities and their status, investigation outcomes, and trend analysis for management review and postmarket surveillance reporting.
* Participate in change control reviews and risk evaluations as the postmarket quality representative; provide historical complaint and CAPA data to inform risk assessments for product and process changes.
* Escalate issues to Quality leadership and serve as the Quality delegate in CAP, CLIA, NYSDOH, and FDA audit or inspection settings as appropriate.

**Must haves:**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, clinical laboratory science, or a closely related field.
* 7+ years of quality assurance experience with direct ownership of a complaint handling or postmarket surveillance program in a regulated environment — IVD, medical device, clinical laboratory, or a combination.
* Working knowledge of CAP/CLIA laboratory complaint and quality event requirements and how they differ from FDA postmarket complaint obligations under 21 CFR 820/QMSR.
* Hands-on CAPA program experience: root cause analysis, corrective action implementation, effectiveness verification, and program-level trending.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor or develop junior quality staff — someone who builds capability in others rather than absorbing work themselves.
* Experience interfacing with external customers or commercial partners on complaint intake, communication, and resolution.
* Strong technical writing skills; ability to produce clear investigation reports, CAPA records, and trend analyses suitable for regulatory review.
* Proficiency with an electronic QMS (eQMS) platform for complaint records, CAPA tracking, and document control.

**Nice to haves:**

* Hands-on experience with CAP LAP inspections (COM, GEN, MOL checklists) and NYSDOH Part 58 laboratory permit requirements.
* Experience in a molecular diagnostics, cfDNA, or NGS-based testing environment.
* Familiarity with MDR evaluation under 21 CFR Part 803 in the context of an LDT/IVD organization.
* Prior experience building or formalizing complaint intake processes between a clinical laboratory and commercial partners or health system clients.
* ASQ CQA or equivalent quality certification.

**Benefits and additional information:**

The US target range of our base salary for new hires is $134,425 - $170,100. You will also be eligible to receive equity, cash bonuses, and a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits depending on the position offered. Please note that individual total compensation for this position will be determined at the Company's sole discretion and may vary based on several factors, including but not limited to, location, skill level, years and depth of relevant experience, and education. We invite you to check out our career page @ *freenome.com/job-openings/* for additional company information.

jobs.title: Hospital Based Patient Advocate
jobs.description:
Make a real difference in patients’ lives—join **Elevate Patient Financial Solutions** as a **Hospital Based Patient Advocate** and help guide individuals through their healthcare financial journey. This full-time position is located 100**% onsite at a hospital in San Francisco, CA,**with a **Monday-Friday schedule from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM**. Driving required must have a valid drivers license.  
  
Bring your passion for helping others and grow with a company that values your impact. In 2024, our Advocates helped over 823,000 patients secure the Medicaid coverage they needed. Elevate’s mission is to make a difference. Are you ready to be the difference?  
  
As a **Hospital Based Patient Advocate**, you play a vital role in guiding uninsured hospital patients through the complex landscape of medical and disability assistance. This **onsite, hospital-based role** places you at the heart of patient financial advocacy—meeting individuals face-to-face, right in their hospital rooms, to guide them through the process of identifying eligibility and applying for financial assistance. Your presence and empathy make a real difference during some of life’s most vulnerable moments.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
The purpose of this position is to connect uninsured hospital patients to programs that will cover their medical expenses. As a Patient Advocate, you will play a critical role in assisting uninsured hospital patients by evaluating their eligibility for various federal, state, and county medical or disability assistance programs through bed-side visits and in-person interactions. Your primary objective will be to guide patients face-to-face through the application process, ensuring thorough completion and follow-up. This role is crucial in ensuring that uninsured patients are promptly identified and assisted, with the goal of meeting our benchmark that 98% of patients are screened at bedside.  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Screen uninsured hospital patients at bedside in an effort to determine if patient is a viable candidate for federal, state, and/or county medical or disability assistance.
* Complete the appropriate applications and following through until approved.
* Detailed, accurate and timely documentation in both Elevate PFS and hospital systems on all cases worked.
* Provide exceptional customer service skills at all times.
* Maintain assigned work queue of patient accounts.
* Collaborate in person and through verbal/written correspondence with hospital staff, case managers, social workers, financial counselors.
* Answer incoming telephone calls, make out-bound calls, and track all paperwork necessary to submit enrollment and renewal for prospective Medicaid patients.
* Maintain structured and timely contact with the applicant and responsible government agency, by phone whenever possible or as structured via the daily work queue.
* Assist the applicant with gathering any additional reports or records, meeting appointment dates and times and arrange transportation if warranted.
* Conduct in-person community visits as needed to acquire documentation.
* As per established protocols, inform the client in a timely manner of all approvals and denials of coverage.
* Attend ongoing required training to remain informed about current rules and regulations related to governmental programs, and apply updated knowledge when working with patients and cases.
* Regular and timely attendance.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications and Requirements**  
  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities.

* Some college coursework preferred
* Prior hospital experience preferred
* Adaptability when dealing with constantly changing processes, computer systems and government programs
* Professional experience working with state and federal programs
* Critical thinking skills
* Ability to maneuver throughout the hospital and patients’ rooms throughout scheduled work shift.
* Proficient experience utilizing Microsoft Office Suite with emphasis on Excel and Outlook
* Effectively communicate both orally and written, to a variety of individuals
* Ability to multitask to meet performance metrics while functioning in a fast-paced environment.
* Hospital-Based Patient Advocates are expected to dress in accordance with their respective Client’s Dress Code.
* Hybrid positions require home internet connections that meet the Company’s upload and download speed criteria. Hybrid employees working from home are expected to comply with Elevate’s Remote Work Policy, including but not limited to working in a private and dedicated workspace where confidential information can be shared in accordance with HIPAA and PHI requirements.

**Benefits**  
ElevatePFS believes in making a positive impact not only within our industry but also with our employees –the organization’s greatest asset! We take pride in offering comprehensive benefits in a vast array of plans that contribute to the present and future well-being of our employees and their families.

* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
* 401K (100% match for the first 3% & 50% match for the next 2%)
* 15 days of PTO
* 7 paid Holidays
* 2 Floating holidays
* 1 Elevate Day (floating holiday)
* Pet Insurance
* Employee referral bonus program
* Teamwork: We believe in teamwork and having fun together
* Career Growth: Gain great experience to promote to higher roles

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
**Office Manager**

* **Location:** San Francisco, CA — Onsite, 5 days/week
* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:00 PM
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time, Non-Exempt
* **Compensation:** $28–35/hour, depending on experience
* **Reports To:** Dr. Benjamin Kruman
* **Desired Start Date:** ASAP

**About The Orofacial Pain Specialty Group**

The (the OPS Group, for short) is a new specialty practice in San Francisco dedicated to providing thoughtful, comprehensive care to patients experiencing complex orofacial pain conditions—TMJ disorders, chronic headaches and migraines, sleep apnea, and related conditions that too often go misdiagnosed or dismissed elsewhere.

The practice is led by , DDS DABOP, a board-certified orofacial pain specialist and Assistant Clinical Professor at UCSF School of Dentistry.

We're built around a simple idea: patients dealing with complex orofacial pain deserve private, unhurried, evidence-based care—especially the ones who haven't found relief anywhere else. That means real time for diagnosis, conservative treatment planning, and a practice that never feels rushed. The Office Manager sets that tone before a patient even sits down in the chair.

We're at the very beginning: a new office, a new team, and a lot still to build.

**About the Role**

The Office Manager is the person who makes the practice run — the first voice a patient hears on the phone, the first face they see when they walk in, and the person keeping everything else on track behind the scenes.

Our practice is built on four values—compassion, communication, innovation, and education—and the Office Manager brings them to life before a patient ever sits down in the chair. Compassion means genuine warmth for people who are often anxious or in pain. Communication means being clear and responsive with both patients and the team. Innovation means helping us build better systems as a brand-new practice figures out how it wants to run. And education means constantly learning—new tools, new processes, better ways to take care of people.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll move fluidly between greeting patients, managing the schedule, ordering supplies, coordinating vendors, and building the systems and processes the practice doesn't have yet because it's brand new. You'll work directly with Dr. Kruman and have real input into how the practice runs day to day—not just executing someone else's playbook, but helping write it.

**We're looking for someone who takes ownership without waiting to be asked.** You'll rarely be told exactly how to do something—you'll be trusted to figure it out, ask good questions when you need to, and follow through. If you notice something's off, you fix it or flag it. That instinct matters more to us than having every process memorized on day one.

**What You'll Do:**

**Patient Experience & Front Desk**

* Welcome patients and create a warm, professional, comfortable experience from the moment they arrive.
* Manage check-in/check-out and keep the front desk organized.
* Schedule and coordinate appointments, follow-ups, and referrals in AthenaHealth.
* Answer phones and respond to patient inquiries clearly and professionally across phone, email, and other channels.
* Maintain a calm, welcoming environment for patients who may be dealing with pain, anxiety, or uncertainty—and protect their privacy and confidentiality at all times.

**Office Operations & Practice Support**

* Own the day-to-day administrative operations of the practice—supplies, vendors, building management, maintenance, deliveries, and general facilities needs.
* Maintain organized files, records, and documentation; support basic financial processes like invoices, payments, and expense tracking.
* Serve as a trusted operational partner to Dr. Kruman—anticipate needs, coordinate his calendar, and solve problems before they become bigger ones.
* Help implement new tools, systems, and processes as the practice grows, and look for ways to improve how things run.
* Assist with onboarding new vendors, partners, and (eventually) team members.
* Build relationships with patients, referring providers, vendors, and the local community—and represent the practice well while doing it.
* Help plan and host occasional events for the practice, its partners, and its patients.

**Who You Are**

You're **warm, capable, organized, and proactive** — the kind of person who notices what needs to happen next and takes it on without being asked twice.

**Requirements**

* 2–3+ years of experience in a role with real people-facing responsibility and operational ownership—healthcare, dental, hospitality, or another high-touch professional services environment
* Front-desk, office administration, or practice coordination experience—or something close enough that the transition is short
* Exceptional organizational skills; you don't let details slip
* Clear, warm communication, in writing and in person
* Real discretion handling sensitive, confidential information
* Ability to hold multiple priorities at once without losing your calm
* Follow-through—you do what you say you're going to do, every time
* Comfortable learning new systems and technology—we'll provide guidance, tutorial videos, and coordinate with AthenaHealth's training resources to get you up to speed on our EHR/scheduling software
* Available in-office 5 days/week, with occasional evening events
* CPR certification required within 2 weeks of your start date—not needed to apply. OPS Group covers the full cost of certification and training.

**Nice to Haves**

* Prior healthcare or dental industry experience
* Familiarity with HIPAA and patient privacy practices

**Why Join Us?**

This is a chance to get in early on a new specialty practice and actually shape how it runs—not step into a fully built machine. The systems, culture, and patient experience here are still being written, and you'll have real input into all of them. As the practice grows, so will your role.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Housing
jobs.description:
**Abode**, one of the largest and effective nonprofits working to end homelessness in the Bay Area, is seeking a Program Manager for our San Mateo County Office in San Mateo, CA.

**About Abode:**

At **Abode**, we believe everyone deserves a safe and stable place to call home. Our mission is to solve homelessness through housing and supportive services that help individuals and families achieve stability and independence. Grounded in the Housing First model, we meet people where they are and provide individualized support based on their needs, goals, and strengths. When you join Abode, you’re not just taking a job, you’re becoming part of a team creating meaningful change in our communities and a commitment to lasting housing stability.

**Our Values:**

We start with dignity, take smart risks, be transparent, solve for today and tomorrow, and spark each other’s strengths in everything we do!

**The Diverse Culture:**

We believe that we make better decisions and provide quality services when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. People of color make up nearly 70% of our workforce and we strive to recruit and retain employees from all backgrounds.

**About The Role**:

The Programs Manager is responsible for the oversight of various Housing Programs serving homeless individuals and families. Key responsibilities include supervision of housing services, close coordination with case management partners, budget and contracts oversight for large public contracts, housing inventory, landlords and property managers, maintaining a close focus on successful outcomes for program participants; to ensure successful program delivery.

**How You Make An Impact**:

* Provide leadership and direction to all Abode Services programs under this umbrella.
* Manage multiple housing programs with the primary function of creating, sustaining, and growing relationships with community partners that enable Abode to provide appropriate housing to participants.
* Act as the primary liaison with all County and City departments and partners.
* Supervise Housing Services Coordinators and Housing Specialists and others, depending on the requirements of a particular program.
* Develop, implement, and monitor housing rental programs for homeless households.
* Supervise and maintain the inventory of affordable, appropriate housing units secured by a participant’s direct lease contract with a landlord.
* Participate as a member of the County Housing Team by attending management meetings, developing housing plans, reviewing budgets, and establishing policies and procedures of various rental subsidy programs.
* Provide assistance and expertise to landlords or service staff for conflict resolution, as appropriate.
* Responsible for contract compliance, reporting, and monitoring for multiple programs and funding streams, including financial reviews, budgets, and projections; chart audits; and managing funder relationships.
* Ensure compliance of Fair Housing rules and regulations, contract requirements and eviction procedures.
* Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual reports which include, but are not limited to the following data: rent, subsidy and participant amounts, occupancy rate, participant demographic information and program eligibility and socio-economic data for monitoring purposes.
* Review monthly rent reports for accuracy, monitor and maintain monthly subsidy balance tracking and projection reports.
* Work closely with the finance team to ensure accuracy as it relates to invoicing to the county.
* Work with funding agencies to provide required information and implementation and monitoring procedures to insure proper data collection and reimbursement.
* Represent Abode Services’ housing programs at meetings with County Social Services Agency, and other collaborative service providers and City jurisdictional stakeholders.
* Submit all data in HMIS and other relevant systems.
* Other duties as assigned.

**How You Meet Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Services, Social Work, Sociology, or related field required.
* 2 years of professional experience in social work, psychology or related fields and demonstrated experience in rental housing programs for low income, special needs households.
* 2 years managing complex contracts in excess of $1M.
* Experience in designing and operating effective programs including the development, implementation, and enforcement of well-designed policies and procedures.
* Use of personal vehicle and proof of valid California Driver's License and current auto insurance, along with a clean DMV record, is required.
* Basic knowledge and understanding of applicable federal, state, and local laws.
* Flexible schedule to work evening and weekend hours as needed.

COMPETENCIES:

* Excellent verbal & written communication, organizational, and time management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* Considerable knowledge of housing programs, including tenant-based rental assistance, master leasing, fair housing principles, tenant rights and responsibilities, and crisis prevention and management.
* Experienced in administrative skills, supporting staff in maintaining proper fiscal and programmatic files, developing, and reviewing reports and invoices, and conducting other tasks to support regulatory compliance.
* Ability to work well independently and collaboratively with teams.
* Ability to understand and adapt existing programs to policy and regulatory changes as needed.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, systems, and platforms.
* Ability to learn and use required mobile devices and business-related applications.

jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Atlanta, GA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience in supply chain operations with an emphasis on demand planning, process mapping, integrated planning, supply/demand management, and labor modeling.
* Experience in data analytics and data center operations.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master's degree with an emphasis in supply chain, operations management, or quantitative disciplines.
* 2 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience establishing and monitoring key forecast performance metrics, specifically focused on improving forecast accuracy and mitigating forecast bias.
* Experience in driving process improvement projects from idea to implementation and adoption.
* Understanding of data center infrastructure, data center operations, technical infrastructure deployments, and specific technician labor requirements for these environments.
* Excellent communication, people management, and data analytics skills with the ability to successfully work across multiple levels of the organization.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Program Manager II, you will lead labor demand planning and forecasting initiatives within our global Supply Chain Planning organization. In this role, you will own the end-to-end forecasting rhythm that determines where, when, and how many data center technicians are needed to deploy, support, and maintain Google’s hyperscale infrastructure.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $132000 - $189000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

* Translate day-to-day business logic, planning rules, and schema definitions into structured functional requirements for engineering teams to build automated solutions.
* Identify, scope, and lead cross-functional improvement programs aimed at advancing Google's labor forecasting capabilities, tool integrations, and operational visibility.
* Leverage modern AI tools and automated workflows to augment scenario simulations, streamline repetitive planning tasks, and improve overall operational efficiency.
