jobs.title: Account Manager -SMB, Growth & Retention (HR Services)
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a self-driven, growth-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid- US-based Account Management team. As an account manager at Rippling, you are the CEO of your book of business. You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back-office HR products and solutions. You will navigate complex customer issues and priorities and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Account managers in our SMB segment own revenue retention and growth of one of our fastest growing customer segments. This is a quota-carrying sales role.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Ensure our customers in the HR Services channel are realizing value and expanding across the platform.
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, introduction calls, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions-based approach
* Navigate a strategic sales process by building relationships with multiple external and internal stakeholders through remote and in-person meetings
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution as part of managing the broader customer relationship
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to monthly targets
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting
* Partner with cross-functional product, support, and customer operations teams to ensure customer success and secure long-term commitments, directly influence Rippling’s product roadmap, and increase operational efficiency
* Take an entrepreneurial approach to the role by being a proactive and strategic partner to customers, tailoring your approach to maximize Rippling product adoption based on each customer’s unique business operations

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a consultative discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive On-Target Earnings (base salary + sales commission) + benefits + equity. The On-Target Earnings\* for employees will be 60/40 commission split for base/variable pay.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

* Commission is not guaranteed

jobs.title: Account Manager - Landscaping
jobs.description:
**Position Overview:** We are seeking a dedicated and results-driven, client & production-facing Account Manager to join our landscaping business. Reporting to the Branch Manager, as an Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of client accounts, building strong relationships, and driving customer satisfaction. You will directly oversee the production Crew Leaders and their teams. You lead and manage them, scheduling and coordinating job execution, and ensuring the successful delivery of landscaping services that meet or exceed client expectations.

**Responsibilities:**

**Safety -** ***Create a Zero-Harm Work Environment***:

* Ensure compliance with national, local, and organizational health and safety regulations and policies.
* Uphold, promote, and monitor the safety culture created by the Branch Manager, ensuring a safe working environment. Ensure proper PPE use through regular inspections. Conduct regular safety meetings, and implement safety training programs.
* Investigate and report any assigned incidents or accidents, taking appropriate corrective actions, and working toward a zero-harm workplace.

  

**Portfolio Performance:**

* The Account Manager is responsible for the management of a landscape maintenance book of business.
* Handle the operational lifecycle of client contracts, from New Customer Onboarding through ongoing Service and property improvements.
* Regularly evaluate actual contractual maintenance financial performance compared to estimates/budgets (hours, materials & subs); organize the team to problem solve irregularities and improve performance.
* Monitor Ancillary project costs and budgets, ensuring profitability and cost-effectiveness.
* Actively address Accounts Payable issues, billing disputes or discrepancies with the customer in a professional and timely manner.

**Customer Relationship Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts, developing and nurturing strong, trust-based relationships.
* Understand the contract, client needs, preferences, and goals, and align our services to meet their requirements.
* Communicate proactively, and conduct regular meetings with clients to provide updates, address concerns, and identify areas for improvement.
* Actively seek client feedback and take proactive measures to enhance client satisfaction and loyalty.

**Ancillary Sales:**

* The Account Manager is responsible for meeting branch-defined monthly and annual Ancillary Sales targets.
* Demonstrate your landscaping expertise and our partnership on our clients properties by proactively identifying and proposing Safety, Functionality, and Aesthetic based Ancillary sales consisting of Enhancement, Irrigation and Tree services.
* Effectively estimate the costs of performing the desired work, and create proposals that target our clients’ needs and expectations, and are priced fairly and ensure our operational teams are profitable.
* Review and approve completed work & client invoices, ensuring accuracy and timely billing. Stay updated on industry trends, competitors, and market conditions to provide valuable insights.

**Job Quality:**

* Cleary understand contract & customer expectations of landscape quality and the high priority areas on each contract site.
* Communicate, train, coach the operational team and ensure execution to these standards.
* Regularly conduct Job Site Quality Audits, evaluating the crews performance on basic Landscape Maintenance tasks, and the individual requirements or expectations of the site; organize the team to problem solve irregularities and improve performance

**Contract Renewals & Retention:**

* Actively seek to retain the clients we want by regularly reaffirming the customers experience.
* Encourage clients to take part in the annual customer satisfaction survey; digest, respond to, and ensure quick actions are taken on identified action items.
* Immediately notify branch leadership when there are relationship challenges (Voluntary or Involuntary) that may put the Job in Jeopardy.
* Provide updates on action items being taken to return the customer and contract to Green Job Health.
* Assemble an annual packet to review the past year’s performance, and work with Branch leadership to propose the renewal contract, with appropriate price-increases, to the client and secure the renewal.

**Production Team Leadership:**

* Promote a culture of safety and ensure compliance with company policies and industry regulations.

jobs.title: Seed Supply Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**Location:** South San Francisco, CA

**Type:** Full-time

**Reports to:** VP, Global Production & Supply

**The Opportunity:**

Ohalo is seeking an agentic AI-capable, hands-on, first-principles leader to plan and manage seed production and supply as the company scales. This person will connect production, R&D, Commercial, and customer delivery around one reliable view of what we expect to produce, what is available to commit, and when customers can receive it.  
  
This is a build role. The Seed Supply Operations Lead will establish the processes, data, systems, and decision rules that connect bioreactor output through seed delivery. The goal is a planning capability that detects changes early, evaluates feasible responses, automates repeatable work, and gives people clear choices when judgment is required. We want someone who can use AI where it improves speed or decision quality, and can demonstrate when a simpler approach works better.  
  
The role has high visibility with Ohalo's leadership team. Its success will be measured by better supply decisions and more reliable customer commitments, not by the number of meetings, dashboards, or AI tools introduced.

**Responsibilities:**

* **An integrated supply picture:** Build a planning model that connects demand, production capacity, expected yield, batch timing, quality status, usable inventory, logistics, and customer commitments. Make uncertainty visible rather than presenting a single forecast as a certainty.
* **The planning operating model:** Establish practical short-, medium-, and long-range planning and decision processes. This may include S&OE and S&OP disciplines, but you will design the cadence around the decisions Ohalo needs to make, rather than inherit a standard meeting structure.
* **Supply and customer commitment decisions:** Create a dependable view of available and projected supply, including the assumptions and release gates behind it. Identify shortages and competing demands early; present allocation and recovery options with their customer and operational consequences. Work with the VP, Global Production & Supply Chain, and Commercial leadership to define who recommends, approves, and communicates consequential commitments and allocation decisions.
* **Scenario planning:** Model the effect of changes in demand, yield, capacity, batch timing, quality release, and logistics. Show leaders the feasible options, trade-offs, and time available to act.
* **AI-enabled workflows:** Identify and deploy specific uses of AI, machine learning, and automation across forecasting, exception detection, scenario analysis, and planning coordination. Define the data, rules, approval points, and performance measures for each use case. Keep people accountable for decisions that require commercial, technical, or operational judgment.
* **Data and systems:** Define the planning data model and the flow of information from source systems into decisions. Partner with technology and functional leaders to select and implement appropriate tools, including APS (Advanced Planning Scheduling), ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), or demand-planning capabilities where justified. Build a foundation that can evolve with Ohalo rather than assuming one system will solve the planning problem.
* **Exceptions and execution:** Establish a clear way to detect, prioritize, assign, and resolve issues such as supply shortfalls, demand changes, batch delays, and quality holds before they become customer-facing problems.
* **Cross-functional alignment:** Bring Production & Supply, R&D, and Commercial together around shared assumptions, a coherent plan, and explicit decisions. Make disagreements and trade-offs visible so leaders can resolve them promptly.
* **Planning performance:** Define and review measures such as forecast accuracy and bias, supply reliability, performance against committed delivery dates, inventory exposure, and exception resolution time. Use the initial operating period to establish baselines and set improvement targets.
* **Capability building:** Develop the processes, documentation, skills, and team structure needed for planning to scale from pilots to commercial volumes.

  

**Candidate Profile**

* Significant experience in supply, demand, production, or integrated planning, including responsibility for improving a planning process across functions. We value demonstrated ability to build and change an operating model more than years spent running an established one.
* Evidence of designing and deploying a data-driven or AI-enabled operational workflow that changed how decisions were made. You can explain the problem, the data and tools used, what was automated or supported, how people adopted it, and what results were achieved.
* Strong understanding of capacity, inventory, demand, and service trade-offs. Able to translate uncertain production outcomes into realistic plans and commitments.
* Comfortable working with biological or process variability, including yield uncertainty, batch timing, and quality release gates.
* Strong systems and data fluency. Able to work from source data through planning logic to operational decisions, and to partner effectively with technical teams.
* Excellent cross-functional leadership. Able to align Production, R&D, and Commercial stakeholders, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive decisions without relying solely on formal authority.
* Comfortable building in an early-stage, fast-moving company. Willing to work directly with data and processes while developing a capability that others can operate and improve.
* Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, a quantitative discipline, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

**Desired Skills/Experience**

* Experience in agribusiness, seed production, biotechnology, biomanufacturing, or another supply chain with uncertain yields and quality release requirements.
* Experience designing AI agents, copilo

This role may be assigned to support either the Non-Destructive Assay (NDA) Lab or the Mission Support Team, within the Integration and Planning ASD, depending on programmatic needs; the assignment will be determined by the hiring team. These positions will be in the Administration Division within the Operations and Business Directorate and are matrixed to the Strategic Deterrence (SD) Directorate.

Do you thrive on creating order, and do you love a role where every day looks different? If you want autonomy, room to run, and a clear path to a Chief of Staff role, all at the cutting edge of AI technology in financial services, then read on!

**Who are we?**
---------------

Veritus was born from a simple belief: the conversations between lenders and their customers deserve better technology. We build AI agents that talk with borrowers by voice, text, email, and chat, from the first loan application through the final payment. Our platform is built for lenders, card issuers, and collection agencies who want to transform their operations with AI. Backed by Y Combinator, Crosslink, and Threshold, our AI agents already handle thousands of conversations every day.

Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

As we scale, we're looking for a hands-on People Operations Generalist to own the day-to-day employee experience, from offer letter to last day, and build the systems that let it scale. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-talent-density environments and would rather fix a broken process and build systems than route tickets.

* Manage and support leave of absence, ADA accommodations, and employee relations related cases with care and discretion, partnering with Legal as needed
* Jump in wherever the team needs you as we grow, from new programs to one-off projects

**You may be a good fit if you have**

* Have 3 - 6 years of experience in People Operations, HR, or a generalist role, ideally at a fast-growing startup
* Have hands-on experience administering Rippling (or a similar HRIS), including workflows, reports, and integrations
* Have managed employment-based immigration cases (H-1B, O-1, green cards) alongside outside counsel

* Are comfortable with data and can turn a messy export into a clear report in spreadsheets

* Handle confidential information with sound judgment and discretion
* Thrive in ambiguity and enjoy building systems from scratch

**Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice-to-have qualifications)**

* People Operations at a hardware, semiconductor, or AI-native company

* Housing subsidy of **$2,500/month** for those living within walking distance of the office
* Daily catered lunch and dinner in our office
* Relocation support for those moving to West San Jose

**Compensation Range**

* $120,000 - $200,000

**How we’re different**

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We think most of the progress in the AI field has come from using more FLOPs to train and run models, and the best way to get more FLOPs is to build model-specific hardware. We are a fully in-person team in West San Jose, and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both as needed.

**Own Every Moment at NetApp**

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

**Strategy and Operations Manager, AI-Native Business Operations**
==================================================================

San Jose, California, United States

**Job category:** Business Operations **Job ID:** 137016-en\_US

**Job Summary**
---------------

This role helps the leaders of NetApp's product organization decide where people and money go, and makes those decisions faster and better informed. It spans planning, forecasting and tracking the organization's people and resources, and the budget across headcount, open reqs, software, cloud and AI spend. On each of these the analyst brings a point of view, not just the numbers behind it.

The role combines three skillsets that usually live in three different people: the consultant who frames an ambiguous question and lands a recommendation with senior leaders; the analyst who builds the model and can defend every number in it; and the AI-first builder who turns recurring work into systems that run themselves. The unit of delivery is a better decision, made sooner, on numbers leaders trust.

The role sits within the AI-Native Business Operations team in the product organization, and reports to the Director, AI-Native Business Operations. The team works in close partnership with Finance, HR, Talent Acquisition and engineering leadership across the product organization.

A few principles shape how the team approaches its work:

* **We start from outcomes, not from tasks.** The first question on any piece of work is what it is for and what good looks like, not how to automate the current steps.
* **One source of truth.** People, plans and spend live in one trusted, connected source, and every report and dashboard draws from it.
* **AI first, with human judgment throughout.** AI shortens the time to an outcome; our judgment tests every assumption and validates each step, from the source data to the final recommendation.
* **Accountability does not stop at the answer.** The analyst stands behind the method and the data as well as the result.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Plan, forecast and track.** Build the plans and forecasts for the product organization's people and resources, and track them month by month: where engineering capacity and spend go across products and investment themes, and how hiring, attrition and backfills move against plan.
* **Manage the budget.** Hold the product organization's spend against target with Finance, from headcount and open reqs to software, cloud and AI, and find where to consolidate, renegotiate or stop.
* **Advise product leadership.** Turn the numbers into a clear point of view for vice presidents and their staff, and run the planning cycles and leadership reviews where those decisions get made.
* **Operationalize strategic initiatives.** Take a leadership priority from idea to working program: define its scope, set milestones and checkpoints, build the plan and put it in motion, then measure the results and keep leadership updated as it lands.
* **Automate the recurring work.** Build agents, automations and dashboards with Claude and the team's other AI tools that make each cycle take less effort than the last.
* **Keep the source of truth trustworthy.** Maintain the connected data behind every leadership view, with the checks and audit trail that let a leader defend any figure in front of Finance or the executive staff.
* **Work across functions.** Partner with Finance, HR, Talent Acquisition, IT and data owners on access, definitions and changes, within NetApp standards for privacy and acceptable use.

**Education**
-------------

* Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience, including a minimum of 3 years in consulting. This experience may have been gained in:

* + The strategy, operations or analytics practice of a management consulting firm, such as McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Deloitte, or a comparable practice
  + A business operations, strategy and operations, or FP&A team at an AI-first technology company
  + A founding or early operating role at a startup building AI-native products

Experience with workforce or finance data in systems such as Workday or Snowflake is a plus.

More than 50 years ago, Walden University was founded to support adult learners in achieving their academic goals and making a greater impact in their professions and communities. Students from across the U.S. and more than 90 countries are pursuing a certificate, bachelor’s, master’s or doctoral degree online at Walden. jobs.title: Digital Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Nerdio**

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

**About the role**

Nerdio is hiring a Digital Program Manager to orchestrate the scaled customer experience across Customer Success. You will own the automated journeys end to end, and act as an internal consultant to the rest of the CS organization: finding friction in the customer journey and removing it with automation and agentic AI.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Digital Customer Success and work alongside the Pooled CS team, but your reach is wider: the plays you build are designed for reuse across Customer Success, so customers get one seamless experience no matter who owns the moment. This is a builder role with no named book of business. You bring the ownership and customer-first urgency of a CAM or TAM to cross-functional programs, and you are comfortable bringing structure to ambiguity.

**What you'll do**

**Orchestrate the scaled customer experience**

* Own the digital journey from onboarding through adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion readiness. Build, launch, monitor, and iterate the plays and automations at each stage.
* Build the triggers and handoffs that bring in a CAM or TAM at the right moment (health thresholds, renewal risk, expansion signals, escalations, champion changes, customer requests), following the coverage model set by the strategy lead.
* Deliver against the current and future-state journey maps owned by the strategy lead. Surface the friction points you find in the data and in the field, and close them so the experience feels the same regardless of who owns the moment.

**Act as an internal consultant to Customer Success**

* Lead discovery with CS teams: ticket analysis, stakeholder interviews, and data review to find where manual, repetitive, or inconsistent work hurts customers or burns CAM/TAM capacity.
* Recommend and build the fix: automation, signal-based triggers, and agentic AI. Give teams plays they can turn on today.

**Lead agentic AI and automation**

* Move the program from static plays to adaptive, agentic journeys for higher-complexity moments, such as personalized onboarding and automated EBR/TVR one-pagers.
* Equip CAMs and TAMs with agentic insights that make their jobs easier and return capacity to them.
* Evaluate tools, run pilots, and set guardrails so AI-driven touches are accurate, on-brand, and hand off to a human when one is needed.

**Run the program and the partnerships**

* Own program and project management from discovery to launch to iteration: scope, plan, sequence, and keep a current view of the roadmap, status, and dependencies.
* Partner with Marketing on every lifecycle communication, RevOps on segmentation and metrics, Product on telemetry and in-app messaging, Support on ticket signals, and Sales on expansion.
* Prove impact. Tie each play to NRR, adoption, and risk reduction, run test-and-learn cycles, and share results broadly.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in digital customer success, lifecycle or adoption marketing, CS operations, or program management for a scaled customer segment.
* A track record of leading cross-functional programs from idea to launch and influencing partners without direct authority.
* A consultative approach: you can run discovery, facilitate working sessions, and turn what you hear into a prioritized plan.
* Hands-on experience with CS, marketing automation, or CRM platforms, and the ability to build or configure automated journeys.
* Practical experience with, or strong curiosity about, AI agents and LLM-based workflows, and sound judgment on where AI should and should not act.
* Data fluency: you use product telemetry, health scores, and attribution to choose what to build and show what worked.
* Strong prioritization, risk management, and written and verbal communication for audiences from CAMs to executives.
* A builder mentality and comfort with ambiguity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B SaaS, cloud, or the Microsoft and MSP ecosystem.
* Experience with Partner Success or Support operations.
* Hands-on use of no-code or low-code agent builders and prompt design.

**Benefits and Incentives**

* Stock Options
* Health and Welfare Plans\*
* Life and Disability Plans\*
* Retirement Plan\*
* Unlimited Flexible Paid Time Off, including your birthday off!
* Collaborative Team Culture
* Benefits for international employees, outside the US, vary by country.

Nerdio is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Nerdio is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age

jobs.title: Merchant Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**Remote.** Open to candidates in Canada or in the following US states: Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Vermont, and Virginia (excluding the New York City, Boston, Philadelphia, and Washington DC metro areas).

### **Who Are We?**

Thanx is a leading loyalty and guest engagement platform for regional and national restaurants. We help brands drive profitable growth by increasing guest frequency, growing digital sales, and reducing reliance on discounts. Most loyalty platforms work for guests who are already loyal. Thanx unifies loyalty, digital ordering, and marketing automation in one platform that turns first-time and casual guests into regulars, treating loyalty as a business outcome, not a program, and engaging across the entire guest base.

Thanx has raised more than $30M from elite investors including M33 Growth, Ribbit Capital, and Sequoia Capital. Our success is rooted in a culture that has attracted some of the best talent in the country, and we are proud of strong employee tenure, a track record of internal promotions, and the company-wide shift to working AI-native over the last 18 months. We credit our cultural "core behaviors" with these accomplishments: Think Boldly, Execute Reliably, Focus on What Matters, Say "Thanx" Genuinely, Encourage Diverse Perspectives, and Lead, Virtually.

### **Who Are You?**

You like figuring out why something broke. A reward didn't apply, a location stopped sending transactions, an order failed. You keep digging until you have an answer you can back up with data.

You're comfortable with technical tools and you pick up new systems quickly. You may not have worked with restaurant POS systems or payments before, and that's fine. You can explain what you found to a merchant or a teammate who doesn't know the technical details.

You already use AI in your daily work, and you want to be somewhere that expects it.

Everyone at Thanx has equity and is expected to operate like an owner. That means real intensity, including evenings and weekends when the work calls for it. If that isn't what you're looking for right now, this isn't the right role. We would rather you know that before you apply than after you start.

### **Position Overview**

Merchant Operations makes sure our restaurant partners' setup works: their loyalty programs, mobile apps, online ordering, and the POS and other integrations behind them. We work closely with the Implementation team to launch merchants, then with Customer Success to make sure the program keeps operating effectively. Our part is the technical configuration, and after launch we monitor location health, investigate issues, and get root causes fixed.

You'll report to the Director of Merchant Operations and Support and work day to day with Support, Customer Success, Implementation, Product, and Engineering. You'll own a real piece of the work from your first months, not a narrow ticket queue.

### **How We Work With AI**

"With great power comes great responsibility." Uncle Ben

AI has changed what a day on this team looks like. Investigating an issue used to mean pulling data from several systems by hand. Now an agent can gather the evidence, and your time goes to figuring out what it means. We build our own monitors, lookups, and triage tools, and we expect everyone on the team to build, not just use them.

These tools are wrong often enough that you have to check the numbers and question the first explanation before anything reaches a merchant or a colleague. That part is still your job.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Configure merchant setups.** Set up and update loyalty, rewards, app, and online ordering for new and existing merchants. This is a high-volume part of the job, so accuracy and speed both matter.
* **Connect partner integrations.** Link merchants to their POS, ordering, and delivery partners, handle credentials, and work with partner teams when something needs their side.
* **Investigate and resolve issues.** Take escalations from Support and Customer Success, work out what is actually happening, and either fix it or give Engineering a clear bug report with the evidence.
* **Monitor location health.** Catch locations that go quiet, integrations that break, and cards that stop transacting before merchants report them.
* **Manage card network enrollment.** Enroll locations with Visa, Mastercard, and Amex, and troubleshoot when transactions don't flow the way they should.
* **Build and improve automations.** Turn repetitive manual work into monitors, lookups, and workflows the whole team can use.
* **Communicate clearly.** Write updates for merchants and teammates that people can act on without a follow-up question.

### **How We Will Know It's Working**

At six months, you're handling the team's core configuration and investigation work on your own, your diagnoses hold up when Engineering reviews them, and you've shipped at least one automation the team uses.

WE ARE HIRING!

Deal Operations Manager — Real Estate (Remote, Contract)

* Company: Portfolio.AI

* Location: Remote (United States)

* Job type: Contract (1099)

* Pay: $750 per deal file / $200,000+ Annually

* Schedule: Monday to Friday, flexible hours; reachable by phone during business hours

**About Portfolio.AI**

Portfolio.AI is a real estate investment and acquisition company. We buy residential and commercial properties across multiple states, often using creative financing such as seller financing, subject-to and assignments. We work with a network of lenders, title companies, agents and an outside transaction coordinator to close several deals each month.

**About the role**

We're hiring a Deal Operations Manager to keep every deal moving from signed contract to closing. You'll be the main point of contact for realtors and the link between our team, lenders, title, our transaction coordinator and our Extension Handler.

This is not a paperwork role — our transaction coordinator prepares and files documents. You own the people side: communication, follow-up, deadlines and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

**What you'll do**

* Introduce the team at the start of every file so all parties know who does what

* Send a complete point-of-contact list (names, roles, phone, email) at handoff

* Collect the realtor for each file and serve as their main point of contact through closing

* Send a weekly deal update on every active file: status, next steps, deadlines and blockers

* Lead a short weekly pipeline call with leadership

* Work with our Extension Handler to secure extensions before any date lapses

* Escalate any stuck or at-risk file within 24 hours, with a suggested fix

* Chase open decisions and outside parties (lenders, title, agents) until each item is resolved

* Track monthly results: days to close, extensions used and deals that fell out

* Build and improve templates and processes as we grow

**Systems you'll run**

* Deal file sheet: sent at kickoff with the buying entity, key principal, loan type, lender rules and every contact

* Entity document vault: a ready packet for each company entity, sent within 1 hour of any request

* Payment watchlist: every fee per file (earnest money, appraisal, extension fees, invoices) with who pays and when

* Decision log: open decisions with an owner and a due date, followed up until made

* Deal tracker: one shared view of every file's stage and next action

**How you'll work with our transaction coordinator**

* The TC handles contracts, signatures, disclosures, title and escrow paperwork, and closing prep

* You handle people and pipeline: the realtor relationship, team updates, follow-ups, extensions and reporting

* The TC flags deadline risks; you act on them with the Extension Handler

*• Simple rule: paperwork goes to the TC, people go to you!*

**What we're looking for**

Required

* 2+ years in real estate transaction coordination, title or escrow, mortgage processing, or real estate operations

* Clear, fast communication by phone, text and email

* Highly organized; able to track deadlines across many files at once

* Comfortable working directly with realtors, lenders, title companies and investors

* Proficient with Google Workspace, spreadsheets and e-signature tools (DocuSign, PandaDoc) Slack for communications

**Nice to have**

* Experience with investor or creative finance deals (seller financing, subject-to, assignments)

* Familiarity with DSCR and Non-QM lending

* Experience closing deals in multiple states

**How success is measured**

* Every file gets a team intro and contact list at handoff

* Weekly updates go out on time, every week

* No deadline lapses without an extension in place

* At-risk files are escalated within 24 hours

* Days to close and extensions used go down over time

**Compensation**

* $750 per deal file managed = $80,000 - $200,000+

* Remote, flexible schedule

* Room to grow as our deal volume increases

**How to Apply**

Apply with your resume and a short note answering two questions:

1. How many active transactions have you managed at once, and what type?

2. Tell us about a time you kept a deal from missing a deadline.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $200,000.00 per year

**About Vivid Life Home Care**
------------------------------

Vivid Life Home Care is a growing network of worker-owned home care cooperatives across California operating under a shared brand and centralized back-office support structure (Vivid Life Cooperative Headquarters). Our mission is to provide world-class home care that blends the best traditions of caregiving with modern, proven practices to create vibrant futures for all.

We partner with independent organizations, including nonprofits and community-based institutions, to build a cooperative ecosystem that improves access to quality care while uplifting caregivers as worker-owners.

**About Our Cooperative Model**
-------------------------------

### **What is a Worker-Owned Cooperative?**

A worker-owned cooperative is an organization owned and governed by its worker-members. In this model, caregivers and staff are not just employees—they are member-owners who participate in decision-making and share in the economic and organizational success of the cooperative.

Key principles include:

* **Democratic governance:** Members participate in decisions that affect their cooperative
* **Shared ownership:** Members contribute to and benefit from organizational performance
* **Local autonomy:** Each cooperative maintains decision-making authority within shared system standards
* **Shared services model:** Headquarters provides centralized systems, infrastructure, compliance, and operational support

Vivid Life operates as a network of independent cooperatives connected through shared systems, standards, and brand infrastructure.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing centralized systems, infrastructure, and daily operational performance across Vivid Life Home Care. This role ensures that Client Success Representatives (CSRs), Cooperative Admins, and caregiver member-owners across the cooperative network are fully supported to deliver high-quality, dignified care through efficient and scalable systems.

This leader serves as the operational backbone of the organization, connecting caregiver experience, client service delivery, and administrative infrastructure into a seamless, high-performing system.

This role combines systems management, training, technical support, implementation leadership, and data analysis across core platforms to drive operational consistency and efficiency.

This is not a traditional operations role. The person in this role will be supporting existing and new co-ops, including supporting caregivers and clients on a day-to-day basis. This will require the Operations Manager to be available and on-call outside of traditional working hours.The Operations Manager serves as the steward of shared infrastructure—creating and establishing standardized systems while preserving cooperative autonomy and local governance authority. This position works under the direction of the Director of Operations and Business Development and requires flexibility to support occasional after-hours and weekend operational needs.

jobs.description:
**Gigstreem**, a leading Internet Service Provider based in the US, provides innovative technology solutions to residential (Single Family, MDU) and commercial (MTU) clients across various markets nationwide.

**SUMMARY**

The Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing maintenance and field service projects to ensure operational reliability and customer satisfaction. This role focuses on managing preventive and corrective maintenance initiatives, service upgrades, and field operations projects, delivering all work on time, within budget, and in compliance with safety and quality standards. The Project Manager will collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the project lifecycle, including scope definition, resource planning, implementation, and post-project performance review. Reports directly to the Director of Field Services.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

jobs.title: Artifact Conservation Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Behind every conserved artifact is a team making sure the right work happens at the right time. ProfessionLX is seeking a part-time Artifact Conservation Project Coordinator to support a National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) initiative preserving collections held by the Presidential Libraries and Museums. These collections—from gifts of state to personal belongings—offer a tangible connection to the people and events that have shaped American history.

You will bring organisation, clarity, and momentum to conservation projects across multiple institutions, working closely with NARA’s project team and library contacts. This role offers an experienced museum, library, or archives professional the opportunity to contribute to a national preservation initiative through a flexible, part-time commitment. Work is remote, averaging approximately 40 hours per month, with occasional in-person meetings as required.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

You will help the project team see the whole picture while keeping individual projects moving. By developing practical tracking tools and reporting templates, maintaining schedules, and staying in regular contact with project leads, you will make progress, upcoming milestones, and outstanding actions easy to follow.

Your ability to turn detailed information into clear, useful documents will be central to the role. Working with the project team, you will help draft statements of work for conservation vendors, prepare narrative and budget reports, and create presentations that explain what has been achieved and what comes next. You will also organise incoming vendor proposals and check them for completeness to support the team’s review.

Alongside the day-to-day coordination, you will help bring colleagues together to share the initiative’s work. This will include arranging project meetings and supporting conservation forums through scheduling, logistics, agenda planning, and presentation preparation. You may also contribute to outreach communications that help others understand the conservation work and its significance.

  
  

### **Requirements**

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING**

* At least 10 years of professional experience in the cultural heritage sector, working within a museum, library, archives, or comparable heritage organisation.
* Relevant experience coordinating artifact conservation projects within the past five years.
* Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and keep multiple projects, deadlines, and follow-up actions in view.
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn contributions from several stakeholders into coherent reports and presentations.
* A collaborative approach to working with specialists and institutional contacts, combined with the initiative to work independently in a remote role.
* Proficiency across Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

**YOUR EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS**

• A college degree in a humanities subject, or equivalent experience relevant to the work described.  

  

  
  

### **Benefits**

We offer great opportunities for personal and professional development in an international company, with a focus on supporting our customers to excel in their strategic goals. The role comes with a competitive salary package, paid time off, Federal holidays, and professional development. You will be a part of a dedicated group of colleagues who value teamwork and collaboration whose focus is to empower our customers.

jobs.title: HV Substation Project Manager
jobs.description:
**BUILT FROM GRIT. POWERING WHAT’S NEXT.**

  

In 2016, we launched **Conductor Power** to compete harder, move faster, and step boldly into renewable energy. Today, under second-generation leadership, every member of our team has been intentionally chosen for their skill, dedication, and shared vision. Together, we combine proven high-voltage expertise with forward-focused Solar EPC and electrical services - setting the pace for the next era of utility innovation. And we’re just getting started.

  

Now, we’re building what’s next.  
And we’re looking for you.

  

**Why This Role Matters**

At Conductor Power, you won’t just take a job - you’ll help power communities, strengthen infrastructure, and advance America’s renewable energy future.

From substations to solar EPC projects, our work is critical, complex, and built to last.

  

**Job Summary:**

The **High Voltage Substation Project Manager** is responsible for managing substation and associated high voltage scopes supporting utility-scale solar and battery energy storage projects. This position oversees planning, engineering coordination, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and closeout while maintaining accountability for safety, quality, schedule, budget, and client satisfaction. The Project Manager coordinates internal teams, subcontractors, suppliers, clients, and interconnecting utilities to deliver reliable facilities that meet contractual and utility requirements.

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

Provides leadership and oversight to assigned project personnel, which may include Assistant Project Managers, Project Engineers, Field Engineers, and project support staff. Coordinates with Substation Superintendents, field leadership, and subcontractors to establish priorities, manage resources, and maintain accountability for execution. Direct reporting relationships may vary based on project size and organizational structure.

  

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Lead substation and associated high voltage scopes from project handoff through commissioning, turnover, and final closeout.
* Develop and maintain execution plans, budgets, schedules, staffing plans, and procurement strategies aligned with contractual milestones.
* Manage sitework, foundations, grounding, steel structures, electrical equipment, buswork, control buildings, cabling, and protection and control scopes.
* Coordinate interfaces between the substation, medium voltage collection system, generation tie line, and utility point of interconnection.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to review drawings, specifications, submittals, and constructability concerns; manage RFIs and design changes through resolution.
* Coordinate procurement, delivery, receiving, and installation of long-lead equipment, including transformers, breakers, switches, and control equipment.
* Work with field leadership to monitor progress, productivity, staffing, equipment needs, and subcontractor performance.
* Manage cost tracking, forecasting, cost-to-complete analysis, billing coordination, and Project Performance Reports (PPRs).
* Identify and document scope changes; prepare and negotiate change orders with supporting cost and schedule impacts.
* Administer subcontract and vendor commitments with Procurement and Contracts to meet scope, schedule, and commercial requirements.
* Serve as a primary project contact for clients, utilities, engineers, subcontractors, and suppliers; lead meetings and communicate performance, risks, and corrective actions.
* Partner with EHS and field leadership to implement safety requirements and coordinate work around existing or energized facilities.
* Ensure quality inspections, hold points, installation records, and testing documentation meet project requirements.
* Coordinate qualified testing and commissioning personnel for equipment testing, relay testing, protection and control verification, and SCADA integration.
* Coordinate outages, utility witness testing, energization readiness, and approved switching activities with authorized utility and commissioning personnel.
* Identify risks, including equipment delays, design conflicts, and utility dependencies; develop mitigation and recovery plans.
* Manage punch lists, as-built drawings, operating and maintenance manuals, warranty information, and final turnover.
* Capture lessons learned and support improvements to project execution processes.
* Complies with all company policies.
* All other duties as assigned or delegated.

**Powering You Forward**

* Medical insurance
* 401(k) with employer match
* Life, AD&D insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Time Off

  

**Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Strong understanding of high voltage substation construction methods, sequencing, equipment, and installation requirements.
* Working knowledge of transformers, breakers, switches, grounding, buswork, protection and control systems, and SCADA.
* Ability to interpret one-line diagrams, electrical schematics, civil and structural drawings, specifications, and contracts.
* Understanding of utility interconnection requirements, testing, commissioning, and energization coordination.
* Knowledge of applicable electrical safety requirements, construction standards, and utility specifications.
* Strong financial and commercial skills, including budgeting, forecasting, subcontract administration, and change management.
* Ability to lead teams, coordinate subcontractors, resolve issues, and manage competing priorities.
* Strong communication, negotiation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel; familiarity with Procore, scheduling software, and ERP systems such as NetSuite preferred.

  

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant construction and project management experience

* Experience managing contingent workers or vendors to a defined brief

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

jobs.description:
Overview:

GovCIO is seeking a **Senior IT Project Manager** to support mission-critical infrastructure modernization programs for the U.S. Coast Guard (USCG). This position will serve as a key technical leader within the PMO, driving the concurrent execution of complex enterprise network tech refreshes, Out-of-Band (OOB) Management system deployments, and legacy VSAT replacement programs across USCG sites. This position will be a fully remote position.

Responsibilities:

As a Senior IT Project Manager, you will serve as the primary leader responsible for the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of complex IT infrastructure and enterprise network projects to ensure USCG mission success. You will coordinate closely with USCG stakeholders, cross-functional engineering teams, field technicians, and vendor partners to ensure smooth technology upgrades with minimal operational disruption. Key responsibilities include:

* Lead, plan, and execute multiple parallel IT infrastructure projects from initiation through closure, focusing heavily on USCG network hardware refreshes, OOB management deployments, and legacy VSAT transitions.
* Define project scope, build detailed work breakdown structures (WBS), maintain integrated master schedules, and proactively manage critical paths to prevent engineering and deployment bottlenecks.
* Identify, track, and mitigate technical, logistical, and timeline risks early; develop comprehensive contingency plans to minimize network downtime during critical cutovers.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for USCG leadership, technical leads, and third-party vendors, ensuring strict adherence to SLAs, delivery timelines, and military regulations.
* Manage project budgets, track expenditures, forecast financial requirements, and coordinate procurement workflows for global network hardware and connectivity services.
* Coordinate the allocation and daily tasks of network engineers, field technicians, site readiness coordinators, and security teams across various USCG deployment locations.
* Quality-check and oversee the submission of all project deliverables, engineering documentation, change management tickets, and Monthly Status Reports (MSRs).
* Drive operational efficiencies by implementing best practices in IT project management and aligning deployments with USCG and federal architecture standards.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's (or equivalent) with 12+ years of experience.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent federal project management certification.
* Proven experience managing large-scale federal contracts or enterprise IT infrastructure deployments, preferably within the DoD, DHS, or USCG environment.
* Direct IT project management experience deploying Out-of-Band (OOB) Management architectures (e.g., Opengear, Perle, Cradlepoint) for remote network resilience.
* Solid understanding of satellite communications, specifically managing legacy VSAT hardware replacements, link migrations, and troubleshooting circuit transitions.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with experience presenting technical deployment strategies and program status briefings to executive-level government stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Project, Excel (advanced formulas/pivots), and integrated PMO tools for tracking schedules, resource allocation, and performance.

Clearance Level: Must be able to attain and maintain a Public Trust

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Technical certifications (e.g., CCNA, CCNP, ITIL) are a strong plus.
* Direct experience supporting U.S. Coast Guard missions, specifically within C5I or similar technical network directorates.
* Expert proficiency in Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project management frameworks using Jira and Confluence.
* Experience managing complex procurement cycles and vendor contracts for global telecommunications and network equipment.

  
Posted Salary Range: USD $140,000.00 - USD $180,000.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Compliance Program Manager
jobs.description:
PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. Our database platform offers developers the fastest and most reliable Postgres and Vitess/MySQL databases, enabling businesses to efficiently handle data and workloads of all sizes.

PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top-tier VCs including a16z, Kleiner Perkins, SignalFire, and Insight Venture Partners. And we serve some of the most innovative companies in the world such as Block, Anysphere (Cursor), MyFitnessPal, Etsy, Kick, and thousands more. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn’t be higher.

We’re look for a Program Manager to oversee the FedRAMP certification process, as well as ongoing management and evolution of our existing compliance commitments, including SOC 1, SOC 2, and PCI DSS compliance. PlanetScale’s security and compliance team is responsible for our corporate information security program, with a goal to reduce risk across our systems, and to establish trust in our product offerings, features, and cloud services. Our work is focused on both our internal employees and our external customers and partners.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Take primary responsibility for overseeing PlanetScale’s FedRAMP readiness and ATO process from start to finish
* Act as the main compliance point of contact for all audits/assessments (i.e. SOC 1 & 2, PCI, FedRAMP) including audit plan preparation, review of documentation and evidence, evaluation of procedures, and external walkthroughs
* Establish, track, and report on key performance indicators and maturity metrics related to audit and compliance programs
* Work collaboratively across many internal teams (IT, Engineering, Legal, and People) to identify, manage, and implement solutions related to privacy, data protection risks, and compliance requirements to help meet our customer’s high expectations for data protection and privacy
* Leverage knowledge of industry standards and best practices to assess the current state of security and compliance risks, identify areas of exposure, and continuously address the gaps by proposing and implementing remediating controls

### **What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of experience contributing to and/or managing audits for a company in the technology sector, including demonstrable experience and subject matter expertise in FedRAMP.
* Experience with SOC 2 and the PCI Data Security Standard, either as a contributor or control owner.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to communicate compliance and privacy related concepts to a broad range of technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Comfort and experience in working in a remote-first organizational, oftentimes asynchronously across many teams and timezones
* Demonstrated success and comfort working with external auditors, outside consultants, and legal affairs
* Experience contributing to and/or managing companywide risk assessments
* Experience and knowledge of cloud service providers and how to interact with them (AWS, Azure, GCP)

#### **What else will help you be successful**

* Experience working with databases, developer tools, infrastructure, or other technical products
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) preferred (CISA, or CISM)
* Working knowledge of SQL, preferably with experience in MySQL and/or PostgreSQL

### **About You**

You are highly organized and able to operate in a startup environment, comfortable with ambiguous or changing situations. You thrive in an environment of cross-department collaboration and feel comfortable working without organizational silos or barriers. You have a passion to lead programs that directly impact and enable our organization to drive higher levels of success. You understand that security and compliance programs are revenue generators and directly influence our ability to sell to and maintain our most demanding customers.

You are comfortable challenging the status quo while staying laser-focused on the task at hand: keeping PlanetScale secure and earning trust with our customers.

### **Why PlanetScale**

We’re redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale — and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Customer Support Engineer, you’ll be on the front lines helping developers and businesses solve real production problems, while also shaping the product, documentation, and support systems that make PlanetScale better for every customer.

PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there’s any way we can make the interview process better for you; we’re happy to accommodate!

#### **Total Compensation and Pay Transparency**

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

**Base salary range:** $175,000 - $200,000 USD

jobs.title: Veterinary CT Clinical Applications and Training Specialist
jobs.description:
The **Veterinary CT Clinical Applications and Training Specialist** is responsible for developing and delivering operational training and applications support for Xoran’s veterinary CT product line. The Specialist will train veterinary practice teams to operate CT systems, acquire technically sound images, and integrate scanning into veterinary patient-care workflows. The role supports customer onboarding, partner trainer development, ongoing education, and product adoption in collaboration with internal teams. Diagnostic interpretation and written radiology reports remain the responsibility of interpreting veterinarians or veterinary radiologists. This full-time, exempt position reports to the President, Veterinary Market.

**Responsibilities**

· Build, implement, and maintain Xoran’s veterinary CT training program, including customer onboarding, practice partner training, operator competency assessments, educational resources, and ongoing program improvement.

· Provide hands-on and remote instruction in CT system operation, patient positioning, image acquisition using approved protocols, reconstruction, technical image-quality assessment, artifact troubleshooting, and transfer of studies for interpretation. Escalate diagnostic questions to the interpreting veterinarian and equipment issues to Service.

· Develop and deliver initial and ongoing CT operator training for veterinary practices and practice partners, including train-the-trainer sessions. Coordinate scanning workflows with the veterinary team responsible for patient preparation, anesthesia, monitoring, and recovery while reinforcing radiation safety and approved operating procedures.

· Develop and deliver internal Sales and Service training to strengthen understanding of veterinary CT operation, patient-care workflows, technical image quality, and product applications.

· Participate in pre-sale customer discussions, demonstrations, conferences and trade shows, and presentations demonstrating system operation and explaining veterinary CT applications within approved product claims.

· Support product training on design changes, software updates, and new product releases, including operational implications for customers, and internal teams.

· Develop and maintain product user manuals, training guides, competency checklists, and other customer- and partner-facing educational content in coordination with appropriate functional owners. Document training completion and use learner feedback to improve training effectiveness.

· Create and maintain technical and training documentation required by Xoran’s Quality Management System and support cross-functional product-development activities with operator feedback and veterinary workflow expertise.

**Qualifications/Requirements**

· Required: Veterinary technician or technologist credentials (such as CVT, LVT, RVT, or equivalent), substantial hands-on veterinary CT experience, and demonstrated ability to train others in CT operation.

· Entrepreneurial drive and the ability to achieve goals in a fast-paced environment.

· Strong technical aptitude for understanding complex technologies; strong interest in emerging veterinary imaging technology and trends.

· Strong customer-facing communication and teaching skills, with the ability to explain CT operation, technical image quality, and veterinary workflows to veterinarians, technicians, clinical staff with varying levels of experience.

· Ability to create clear product training, clinical-workflow, and technical documentation and evaluate operator competency.

· Ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product Development, Quality, Service, veterinary clients.

· Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% to customer and customer sites, training events, conferences and trade shows, and internal meetings, sometimes on short notice.

**Education & Experience**

· Education in veterinary technology or veterinary nursing through an accredited degree or certificate program, or an equivalent recognized pathway to veterinary technician credentialing. A veterinary medical degree (DVM or VMD) is not required.

· Optional: Veterinary Technician Specialist in Diagnostic Imaging (VTS-DI) certification.

· Demonstrated experience performing veterinary CT studies, including patient positioning, scan acquisition, reconstruction, technical image-quality assessment, and coordination with the veterinary patient-care team.

· Equivalent experience training, coaching, or assessing CT operators. Experience delivering customer onboarding, practice partner education, or equipment demonstrations is preferred.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
The International Research Olympiad (IRO) is a premier global STEM competition that tests science research ability for students aged 13–18. Students from more than 89 countries have taken part, making IRO the largest global community of young students interested in research.

Unlike traditional science olympiads that focus on specific subjects, IRO builds skills useful in any research discipline. Participants deepen their understanding of the scientific process and develop creativity, critical thinking and analysis skills, forming a foundation for later success. IRO is supported by a Board of Advisors and a growing network of partner organizations, including Indigo Research, Punjab Group and Google for Nonprofits, and runs student programs such as IRO Clubs and the IRO Ambassador program.  
  
The IRO Program Manager will be the dedicated full-time owner of IRO’s growth and day-to-day running. You will be accountable for growing registrations and paid participation, building the partnerships, clubs and community that bring students in, and running the competition smoothly as it scales.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. IRO already has a large global audience and an engaged student community; your job is to turn them, together with school and organizational partnerships, into a repeatable growth engine. You will work closely with IRO’s leadership, Board of Advisors, partner organizations, ambassadors and schools, and you are accountable not simply for running the competition, but for growing it.

### **Growth & Partnerships**

* Identify current and future mentor shortages in specific disciplines.
* Lead end-to-end recruitment efforts, including drafting job descriptions, posting roles, proactive sourcing, conducting interviews and sending offers and contracts.
* Provide training and onboarding for mentors to ensure a seamless transition into the program.
* Organize regular quality review meetings with mentors to discuss performance, share best practices, and drive continuous improvement.

### **Competition Operations & In-Person Finals**

* Coordinate the full competition cycle, including registration, online rounds, the in-person Finals, results, awards and certificates
* Keep practice exams, curriculum resources and rules up to date for students and teachers
* Provide clear, timely support to students, parents, teachers and partners throughout the cycle
* Own end-to-end logistics for the in-person IRO Finals, from venue selection and contracting through to event day
* Manage the Finals budget, vendors, catering, AV, signage, printed materials and awards
* Coordinate finalist communications, including invitations, registration, travel and accommodation guidance, visa letters and on-site schedules
* Plan the Finals program, including the exam, presentations, judging, ceremonies and networking, with advisors, judges, partners and volunteers
* Ensure student safety and wellbeing on site, including chaperone requirements, consent forms and emergency procedures
* Build processes and run post-event reviews so IRO and its Finals run smoothly at much higher volume without compromising quality

### **Board of Advisors & Reporting**

* Serve as the main point of contact for IRO’s Board of Advisors, managing communication, onboarding and day-to-day relationships
* Plan and run Board meetings, including scheduling, agendas, briefing materials, minutes and follow-up on action items
* Coordinate Board involvement in the competition, including exam and question review, judging, awards and the Finals
* Recruit and onboard new advisors as IRO grows, keeping Board profiles and public listings up to date
* Keep the Board informed with regular updates on registrations, results, partnerships and key decisions
* Create dashboards and regular reporting on registrations, revenue and partner performance for IRO leadership and the Board
* Track participant data accurately so outcomes, alumni and partner impact can be measured over time

### **Required Skills:**

* 1–3 years of experience in partnerships, program operations, events or growth
* Experience doing outreach to schools, educators or organizations and following through to signed partnerships
* Experience planning and running in-person events, ideally for students or international attendees
* Experience supporting a board, advisory group or senior stakeholders, including meetings and communications
* Experience coordinating multi-stakeholder projects with fixed deadlines
* Background in education, research, STEM, competitions or youth programming is a plus
* Experience in research competitions or olympiads, as a participant or organizer, is a plus

**Job Overview**

The Director of School Operations (DSO) is a senior, enterprise-level leadership role responsible for operational excellence across a portfolio of Connections Academy schools. The DSO focuses on strengthening the effectiveness of school leaders and leadership teams through hands‑on partnership, coaching, and operational problem‑solving. This role directly manages the primary school leader and at each school will work directly with principals, directors, and school leadership teams to ensure schools are operationally strong, well‑supported, and positioned to serve students successfully.

The DSO uses a multi-layer leadership model to ensure alignment and execution of school operations to PVS standards and values. This is accomplished by supporting operational systems, compliance structures, and leadership accountability through school-based leadership teams. The scope of this role is inherently complex and high-impact, requiring a majority of time spent working directly with schools, the ability to lead leaders, operate at scale, and balance competing priorities across multiple schools and PVS simultaneously.

The DSO works in a number of cross-functional teams identified as key members to accomplish school goals. This includes close partnership with the School Success Partner (SSP), who holds overall accountability for school/account success and continuity of operations. In addition, they provide critical support to operationalize and hold leaders accountable for academic improvement strategies identified by the Academic Outcomes Teams.

**Role Purpose**

* Lead operational execution across multiple schools and leadership teams.
* Ensure compliance with regulations and contract requirements, operational efficiency, and sustainability at scale.
* Strengthen school leader effectiveness, stability, and succession
* Enable enrollment growth through operational readiness while maintaining a focus on student experience and success.
* Partner with SSP to translate account strategy into disciplined, scalable execution
* Support academic improvement by holding school leaders accountable to initiatives established by the Academic Outcomes team who holds academic accountability.
* Ensure Connections Academy model is implemented with fidelity and overall alignment to Pearson values.

* Portfolio-Level School Operations Leadership

* Directly manage and coach multiple school leaders across a portfolio of schools.

* Hold school leaders accountable for execution of:
* Academic action plans and initiatives
* Compliance and charter/SOA requirements
* School year cycle milestones and operational deliverables
* Monitor operational health, engagement trends, and compliance indicators across schools to identify risks and required interventions.
* Provide structured, data-informed coaching to leaders to improve execution at scale.

* Operational Sustainability & Enrollment Enablement

* Work closely with schools to ensure they are operationally prepared to support enrollment growth.
* Validate leadership capacity, staffing structures, onboarding processes, scheduling, and systems readiness at each school.
* Identify school operational constraints that could limit growth, persistence, or staff sustainability.
* Strengthen retention-supporting school practices that indirectly impact student and staff experience.
* Identify risks to charter stability and renewal readiness and work across PVS departments to mitigate risks.

* School Year Cycle & Operational Readiness at Scale

* Ensure consistent execution of school year cycle activities across multiple schools, including:
* Calendar and handbook alignment
* Annual policy and process reviews
* Summer school planning
* Identify strain points affecting leaders and staff and coordinate mitigations across the portfolio of schools.

* Serve as a leader of leaders, managing school principals responsible for large, complex organizations.
* Establish clear performance expectations tied to operational excellence, compliance, and execution of strategic (academic, financial, etc.) initiatives.
* Conduct performance evaluations and manage development plans for school leaders.
* Lead hiring and onboarding of school leaders.
* Drive succession planning to ensure leadership stability across schools.
* Facilitate leadership development that cascades through leadership teams and school staff.

* Support operational change across multiple schools and leadership teams as PVS launches new products and services.
* Ensure adoption of enterprise systems, processes, and initiatives while working to minimize disruption to all stakeholders.

DoorDash's marketing product operations team is the connective tissue between our Retention Marketing organization and the tools, systems, and data that power it. You'll partner closely with Campaign Operators to find where manual work slows them down. * Identify high-effort manual steps in campaign build and edit workflows and design AI-assisted automations to replace them
* Apply AI to campaign QA and ongoing monitoring so issues are caught early and surfaced quickly across all audiences
