**Department:** Learning & Development (L&D)  
**Reports To:** Director of Learning & Development  
**Position Type:** Full-Time  
**Salary Range:** $75,000 – $90,000 / year

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a performance-minded, strategic **Learning and Development Strategist** to align our organizational growth objectives with targeted capability-building strategies. Moving away from a simple "order-taking" approach to corporate training, you will act as an internal management consultant. You will embed directly with business unit leaders to diagnose performance bottlenecks, forecast critical skills gaps, and co-create impactful human-centered learner journeys. The ideal candidate pairs AI fluency and skills and data literacy with adult learning expertise to shift our L&D team from a cost center to a core performance enabler.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Business Consulting & Intake**

* Act as the dedicated L&D interface and trusted advisor for assigned functional business units.
* Conduct root-cause performance consultations with department leaders to determine whether productivity blocks stem from skills deficiencies or from separate process, technical, or talent challenges.
* Build strong, collaborative ties with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) to weave learning infrastructure tightly into broader talent pipelines, internal mobility routes, and success planning initiatives.

**Capabilities Assessment & Strategy Design**

* Apply qualitative and quantitative data methodologies to map active skill inventories, identify current workforce blind spots, and forecast future capability shifts.
* Use AI-assisted tools to synthesize findings and identify patterns, themes, and opportunities.

* Support and guide development of learning and program materials that integrates AI-assisted creation and review

* Map blended, adaptive learner journeys combining structured training modules with informal social loops and job-embedded experiential training.
* Partner with instructional design colleagues to deliver contextually precise, localized learning interventions.

**Program Governance, Metrics & ROI**

* Define success metrics that connect learning initiatives to performance outcomes
* Use data and analytics to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement
* Continuously refine learning programs based on feedback, performance data, and business needs
* Support the development of dashboards and reporting tools that provide visibility into learning impact

**Qualifications & Competencies**

* 5–8+ years of experience in Learning & Development, instructional design, or performance consulting
* Strong foundation in adult learning principles, instructional design, and curriculum development
* Experience conducting learning needs analysis and translating findings into structured solutions
* Demonstrated use of AI tools (LLMs, content generation, workflow automation) in a professional setting
* Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actionable learning strategies
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

new_jobs.description:
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a **Front Office Manager** , you’re not just overseeing daily front office operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

  

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

* **Manage daily front office operations:** Oversee Front Office activities including guest service, registration, room inventory, and adherence to policies and standards
* **Monitor and elevate service:** Track guest satisfaction, address service issues, and guide the team to implement improvements that enhance the guest experience
* **Implement revenue initiatives:** Promote hotel services and execute up-selling tactics to drive room occupancy and revenue growth
* **Facilitate team knowledge:** Provide regular updates and training to ensure the team is well-informed of hotel offerings, services, and local attractions
* **Delight our guests:** Welcome guests, respond to inquiries, and resolve concerns promptly to uphold service standards
* **Inspire and develop the team:** Supervise and support front office team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

  

**What It Takes to Make the Stay**

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

  

**How We'll Help You Thrive**

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including\*:

* **Incredible travel perks** – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
* **Own a piece of Hilton** – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
* **Paid parental leave** – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
* **Personalized caregiving support** – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
* **Crisis concierge** – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
* **Mental health resources** – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* **Generous paid time off (PTO)** – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
* **Health & welfare benefits** – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
* **Financial security for your future** – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next

*\*Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.*

  

**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

new_jobs.title: Associate Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Who we are**

CloudKitchens helps restaurateurs around the world succeed in online food delivery - our goal is to make food more affordable, higher quality, and convenient for everyone.

We take underutilized properties and transform them into smart kitchens so they can better serve restaurateurs, customers, and the neighborhoods they're in. Every time we launch a new facility we create jobs in that neighborhood, and we're proud to provide a wide range of cuisines and options for healthy food at an affordable price.

We're changing the game for restaurateurs, whether they're entrepreneurs opening their first restaurant, all the way through to your favorite global quick-service restaurant chains.

  

**What you'll do**

As an Associate Operations Manager at one of our CloudKitchen facilities, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing daily operations, ensuring facility maintenance, working to get prospective partners onboarded, and delivering exceptional customer support.

**Responsibilities**

**Team Management**

* Lead and train a dedicated facility team, handling scheduling, training, and performance management.
* Manage an efficient order fulfillment process and deliver excellent customer service.
* Manage a janitorial team; uphold cleaning and sanitation protocols, ensuring compliance with local health and safety regulations.
* Cultivate a positive and inclusive work environment, fostering teamwork and communication across teams and departments.

**Sales**

* Leading facility tours where you will proactively engage with restaurants as part of relationship building, and leading the overall sales pitch
* Develop and maintain internal relationships to set proper expectations with potential customers and continually seek out value-added opportunities (for customers) that other teams can test out.

**Customer Support and Retention**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for restaurant partners, building and maintaining trusting relationships, and solving any issues that arise.
* Quarterback the onboarding process for new restaurant partners, including assistance with permits, online delivery platform setup, and launch strategy planning.
* Manage the overall partner experience, preventing churn, and extending partner lifecycle.

**Administrative & Strategic**

* Participate in planning sessions with management and peers, utilizing data to make decisions.
* Review and report KPI metrics to facility management and contribute to goal setting.
* Manage and report the facility P&L, understanding key drivers for achieving facility-level profitability.

**Building Repair and Maintenance**

* Conduct routine inspections and maintenance audits on HVAC units, refrigeration units, water heaters, and ice machines with training and support from subject matter experts.
* Perform general upkeep and handle minor repairs and maintenance; coordinate with external vendors for specialized services.

  

**What we're looking for**

* Operations Management: 2 years (Preferred)
* Employee Management/Assistant Management: 2 years (Preferred)
* Restaurant Management: 2 years (Preferred)
* Property Management: 2 years (Preferred)

  

**Why join us**

* Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.
* Changing the restaurant industry: You'll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery.
* Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you'll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer's success.

  

**What else you need to know**

This role is based in our San Mateo office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We're constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That's why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

The base salary range for this role is **$66,000 - $78,000 per year.**

Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You may also be eligible for equity awards and an annual performance-based bonus.

**Benefits Summary (USA Full-Time Exempt Employees):**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (multiple plans, incl. HSA options).

* Voluntary insurance: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity.

* Budget development and management.
* Ability to run larger, more complex projects.
* Effectively delegate project tasks to project management team.

* Other duties as assigned.

* Knowledge and experience planning, managing & coordinating all aspects of project, scope and cost for multiple projects.
* Demonstrated ability to monitor and re-evaluate scope throughout the project and recommend adjustments when necessary.

* Experience with Value Engineering

* Utilize effective written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to understand how your role contributes to the organization's goals.
* Deliver quality work product by role modeling organizational core values.

* Consistently communicate and collaborate with team members and clients.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager - Devices Beta Team, Amazon Devices Beta
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Amazon Devices Beta (ADB) Team is your hall pass to play at work!! We are responsible for the “real world validation” for Kindle eReaders, Fire Tablets, FireTV products, and Emerging products…think, Amazon Smart Oven and Amazon Basics Microwave. How do we do this? By playing with these products every day! We work with product and engineering teams to prepare new product launches, system software and app updates, and marketplace expansions. Our goal is to gather feedback and expose issues and bugs prior to the product launching, so we delight our customers with products beyond their expectations.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The ADB Team needs an experienced Program Manager to help us build and execute programs to validate the customer experience during the product development cycle. You will work with end users and a wide variety of internal teams to develop the strategy and execute the program to confirm from a customer perspective we are ready to launch. You will be a “hands on” contributor to support and troubleshoot issues, resolve problems, and keep the feedback flowing. Along the way, you’ll identify opportunities for improvements and put processes and tools in place to help us scale. You will track, communicate status, and independently drive issues to resolution. Cross-team coordination, program management, and an ability to learn and understand new technologies are essential.  
  
A day in the life  
Our programs are global and composed of Amazon employees across the company. We put pre-released devices and/or software in the hands of beta testers who represent our target customer profile ("people all about smart home automation", "people who love to read", or "people who are native speakers of French"). Working with our product team counterparts, we ask testers for “no holds barred” feedback to tell us what works and what needs to be fixed. Our bar is always being raised and we strive to achieve an Amazon 4-Star or better product every time!  
  
About the team  
The Amazon Devices Beta Team is responsible pre-launch customer feedback for our products. The team is composed of program managers who love technology and devices. Together with product owners, we plan and execute beta programs focused on gathering early customer feedback to help Amazon ship devices and software that delight customers. Our objective is to leverage the voice of the customer to validate and improve the experience and make an informed decision regarding launch readiness.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

**About this opportunity:**

  

Freenome is approaching FDA approval and commercial launch of SimpleScreen™, our cfDNA-based colorectal cancer detection test. As we cross that milestone, we need a dedicated owner for the postmarket quality infrastructure that commercial launch demands — someone who can build and run a complaint handling program that works across two distinct regulatory environments.

  

This role also owns the CAPA program — ensuring that complaints and quality events drive real corrective action, not just documentation. You will serve as the escalation point and technical mentor for junior team members managing non-conformances and laboratory incidents, and you will be the Quality interface with our commercial partners to ensure customer and partner feedback is captured, evaluated, and acted on. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant cross-functional influence and a mentorship mandate. The role reports directly to the Senior Director, Quality Assurance and is an onsite role based in our Brisbane, California headquarters.

  

**What you'll do:**

* Own the end-to-end complaint handling process — from intake and triage through technical investigation, root cause analysis, disposition, and closure — applying the distinct regulatory requirements applicable to CAP/CLIA laboratory quality events and IVD postmarket complaints under 21 CFR 820/QMSR and ISO 13485.
* Own the CAPA program: ensure that complaints, non-conformances, and laboratory quality events drive rigorous corrective action with documented root cause analysis, implementation, and effectiveness verification. Maintain CAPA records in the eQMS with traceability required for CAP/CLIA compliance.
* Serve as the escalation point and technical mentor for junior team members managing non-conformances and laboratory incidents — coaching investigation rigor, reviewing findings, and ensuring quality events at all levels feed appropriately into the CAPA program.

* Monitor and analyze complaint, CAPA, and non-conformance trends across all quality event streams; identify systemic issues and escalate with supporting analysis and recommended corrective actions to Quality leadership.
* Compile and present quality signals data: complaint volumes, CAPA quantities and their status, investigation outcomes, and trend analysis for management review and postmarket surveillance reporting.
* Participate in change control reviews and risk evaluations as the postmarket quality representative; provide historical complaint and CAPA data to inform risk assessments for product and process changes.
* Escalate issues to Quality leadership and serve as the Quality delegate in CAP, CLIA, NYSDOH, and FDA audit or inspection settings as appropriate.

**Must haves:**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, clinical laboratory science, or a closely related field.
* 7+ years of quality assurance experience with direct ownership of a complaint handling or postmarket surveillance program in a regulated environment — IVD, medical device, clinical laboratory, or a combination.
* Working knowledge of CAP/CLIA laboratory complaint and quality event requirements and how they differ from FDA postmarket complaint obligations under 21 CFR 820/QMSR.
* Hands-on CAPA program experience: root cause analysis, corrective action implementation, effectiveness verification, and program-level trending.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor or develop junior quality staff — someone who builds capability in others rather than absorbing work themselves.
* Experience interfacing with external customers or commercial partners on complaint intake, communication, and resolution.
* Strong technical writing skills; ability to produce clear investigation reports, CAPA records, and trend analyses suitable for regulatory review.
* Proficiency with an electronic QMS (eQMS) platform for complaint records, CAPA tracking, and document control.

**Nice to haves:**

* Hands-on experience with CAP LAP inspections (COM, GEN, MOL checklists) and NYSDOH Part 58 laboratory permit requirements.
* Experience in a molecular diagnostics, cfDNA, or NGS-based testing environment.
* Familiarity with MDR evaluation under 21 CFR Part 803 in the context of an LDT/IVD organization.
* Prior experience building or formalizing complaint intake processes between a clinical laboratory and commercial partners or health system clients.
* ASQ CQA or equivalent quality certification.

**Benefits and additional information:**

The US target range of our base salary for new hires is $134,425 - $170,100. You will also be eligible to receive equity, cash bonuses, and a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits depending on the position offered. Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

**Job Summary**

As we scale, we're looking for a hands-on People Operations Generalist to own the day-to-day employee experience, from offer letter to last day, and build the systems that let it scale. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-talent-density environments and would rather fix a broken process and build systems than route tickets.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the employee lifecycle end-to-end, including pre-hire, onboarding, new hire orientation, and offboarding, so hires are ready to go from day one
* Manage immigration processes for our team, partnering with outside counsel to keep cases on track
* Own Rippling as our HRIS, building workflows and reports and keeping employee data accurate
* Build and improve People systems and processes, automating repetitive work where we can
* Handle core People Ops work, from employee questions and leaves to compliance and offboarding
* Develop, implement, and maintain HR compliance programs, employee policies, and handbooks as the organization scales
* Analyze headcount, hiring, and engagement data, and turn it into clear recommendations for leadership
* Partner closely with Finance, Legal, IT, and Recruiting on cross-functional initiatives to mature company processes, policies, and operational efficiency
* Support employee recognition and team-building efforts, from celebrating wins to planning events that bring the team together
* Manage vendor relationships such as insurance and benefit brokers, including worker's compensation, legal counsel, and EORs
* Manage and support leave of absence, ADA accommodations, and employee relations related cases with care and discretion, partnering with Legal as needed
* Jump in wherever the team needs you as we grow, from new programs to one-off projects

**You may be a good fit if you have**

* Have 3 - 6 years of experience in People Operations, HR, or a generalist role, ideally at a fast-growing startup
* Have hands-on experience administering Rippling (or a similar HRIS), including workflows, reports, and integrations
* Have managed employment-based immigration cases (H-1B, O-1, green cards) alongside outside counsel
* Proficiency with modern workplace tools such as Jira, Slack, Ironclad, and GSuite
* Are comfortable with data and can turn a messy export into a clear report in spreadsheets
* Have working knowledge of California and federal employment law, leaves, and benefits administration
* Handle confidential information with sound judgment and discretion
* Thrive in ambiguity and enjoy building systems from scratch

**Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice-to-have qualifications)**

* People Operations at a hardware, semiconductor, or AI-native company
* Supporting a team through rapid scaling, such as 500 to 1000+
* Experience with employee relations, including investigations and case management
* Global experience (APAC and/or EMEA) supporting people ops or entity
* Recruiting or ATS administration (Ashby or similar)
* Scripting, or no-code automation tools for People data and workflows
* Proficiency with leveraging AI tools such as Claude and Harvey.ai
* Equity administration (Carta or similar)

**Benefits**

* Full medical, dental, and vision packages, with generous premium coverage
* Housing subsidy of **$2,500/month** for those living within walking distance of the office
* Daily catered lunch and dinner in our office
* Relocation support for those moving to West San Jose

**Compensation Range**

* $120,000 - $200,000

**How we’re different**

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We think most of the progress in the AI field has come from using more FLOPs to train and run models, and the best way to get more FLOPs is to build model-specific hardware. Larger and larger training runs encourage companies to consolidate around fewer model architectures, which creates a market for single-model ASICs.

We are a fully in-person team in West San Jose, and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both as needed.

new_jobs.title: Strategy and Operations Manager, AI-Native Business Operations
new_jobs.description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

**Strategy and Operations Manager, AI-Native Business Operations**
==================================================================

San Jose, California, United States

**Job category:** Business Operations **Job ID:** 137016-en\_US

**Job Summary**
---------------

This role helps the leaders of NetApp's product organization decide where people and money go, and makes those decisions faster and better informed. It spans planning, forecasting and tracking the organization's people and resources, and the budget across headcount, open reqs, software, cloud and AI spend. On each of these the analyst brings a point of view, not just the numbers behind it.

The role combines three skillsets that usually live in three different people: the consultant who frames an ambiguous question and lands a recommendation with senior leaders; the analyst who builds the model and can defend every number in it; and the AI-first builder who turns recurring work into systems that run themselves. The unit of delivery is a better decision, made sooner, on numbers leaders trust.

The role sits within the AI-Native Business Operations team in the product organization, and reports to the Director, AI-Native Business Operations. The team works in close partnership with Finance, HR, Talent Acquisition and engineering leadership across the product organization.

A few principles shape how the team approaches its work:

* **We start from outcomes, not from tasks.** The first question on any piece of work is what it is for and what good looks like, not how to automate the current steps.
* **One source of truth.** People, plans and spend live in one trusted, connected source, and every report and dashboard draws from it.
* **AI first, with human judgment throughout.** AI shortens the time to an outcome; our judgment tests every assumption and validates each step, from the source data to the final recommendation.
* **Accountability does not stop at the answer.** The analyst stands behind the method and the data as well as the result.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Plan, forecast and track.** Build the plans and forecasts for the product organization's people and resources, and track them month by month: where engineering capacity and spend go across products and investment themes, and how hiring, attrition and backfills move against plan.
* **Manage the budget.** Hold the product organization's spend against target with Finance, from headcount and open reqs to software, cloud and AI, and find where to consolidate, renegotiate or stop.

Deal Operations Manager — Real Estate (Remote, Contract)

* Company: Portfolio.AI

**About Portfolio.AI**

Portfolio.AI is a real estate investment and acquisition company. We buy residential and commercial properties across multiple states, often using creative financing such as seller financing, subject-to and assignments. We work with a network of lenders, title companies, agents and an outside transaction coordinator to close several deals each month.

**About the role**

We're hiring a Deal Operations Manager to keep every deal moving from signed contract to closing. You'll be the main point of contact for realtors and the link between our team, lenders, title, our transaction coordinator and our Extension Handler.

This is not a paperwork role — our transaction coordinator prepares and files documents. You own the people side: communication, follow-up, deadlines and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

**What you'll do**

* Introduce the team at the start of every file so all parties know who does what

* Send a complete point-of-contact list (names, roles, phone, email) at handoff

* Work with our Extension Handler to secure extensions before any date lapses

* Escalate any stuck or at-risk file within 24 hours, with a suggested fix

* Chase open decisions and outside parties (lenders, title, agents) until each item is resolved

* Track monthly results: days to close, extensions used and deals that fell out

* Build and improve templates and processes as we grow

**Systems you'll run**

* Deal file sheet: sent at kickoff with the buying entity, key principal, loan type, lender rules and every contact

* Entity document vault: a ready packet for each company entity, sent within 1 hour of any request

* Payment watchlist: every fee per file (earnest money, appraisal, extension fees, invoices) with who pays and when

* Decision log: open decisions with an owner and a due date, followed up until made

* Deal tracker: one shared view of every file's stage and next action

**How you'll work with our transaction coordinator**

* The TC handles contracts, signatures, disclosures, title and escrow paperwork, and closing prep

* You handle people and pipeline: the realtor relationship, team updates, follow-ups, extensions and reporting

* The TC flags deadline risks; you act on them with the Extension Handler

*• Simple rule: paperwork goes to the TC, people go to you!*

**What we're looking for**

Required

* 2+ years in real estate transaction coordination, title or escrow, mortgage processing, or real estate operations

* Clear, fast communication by phone, text and email

* Highly organized; able to track deadlines across many files at once

* Comfortable working directly with realtors, lenders, title companies and investors

* Proficient with Google Workspace, spreadsheets and e-signature tools (DocuSign, PandaDoc) Slack for communications

**Nice to have**

* Experience with investor or creative finance deals (seller financing, subject-to, assignments)

* Familiarity with DSCR and Non-QM lending

* Experience closing deals in multiple states

**How success is measured**

* Every file gets a team intro and contact list at handoff

* Weekly updates go out on time, every week

* No deadline lapses without an extension in place

* At-risk files are escalated within 24 hours

* Days to close and extensions used go down over time

**Compensation**

* $750 per deal file managed = $80,000 - $200,000+

* Remote, flexible schedule

* Room to grow as our deal volume increases

**How to Apply**

Apply with your resume and a short note answering two questions:

1. How many active transactions have you managed at once, and what type?

2. Tell us about a time you kept a deal from missing a deadline.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $200,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

**About Vivid Life Home Care**
------------------------------

Vivid Life Home Care is a growing network of worker-owned home care cooperatives across California operating under a shared brand and centralized back-office support structure (Vivid Life Cooperative Headquarters). We partner with independent organizations, including nonprofits and community-based institutions, to build a cooperative ecosystem that improves access to quality care while uplifting caregivers as worker-owners.

**About Our Cooperative Model**
-------------------------------

### **What is a Worker-Owned Cooperative?**

A worker-owned cooperative is an organization owned and governed by its worker-members. In this model, caregivers and staff are not just employees—they are member-owners who participate in decision-making and share in the economic and organizational success of the cooperative.

Key principles include:

* **Democratic governance:** Members participate in decisions that affect their cooperative
* **Shared ownership:** Members contribute to and benefit from organizational performance
* **Local autonomy:** Each cooperative maintains decision-making authority within shared system standards
* **Shared services model:** Headquarters provides centralized systems, infrastructure, compliance, and operational support

Vivid Life operates as a network of independent cooperatives connected through shared systems, standards, and brand infrastructure.

**Position Summary**

This role combines systems management, training, technical support, implementation leadership, and data analysis across core platforms to drive operational consistency and efficiency.

This is not a traditional operations role. The person in this role will be supporting existing and new co-ops, including supporting caregivers and clients on a day-to-day basis. This will require the Operations Manager to be available and on-call outside of traditional working hours.The Operations Manager serves as the steward of shared infrastructure—creating and establishing standardized systems while preserving cooperative autonomy and local governance authority. This position works under the direction of the Director of Operations and Business Development and requires flexibility to support occasional after-hours and weekend operational needs.
